name: D-aspartic acid
description:
D-Aspartic acid (CAS 1783-96-6 ), commonly abbreviated as D-Asp, is the D-enantiomer of aspartic acid used across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and personal care applications.

It functions as a chelating agent, pH buffer, and humectant depending on the formulation context. In pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturing, D-Asp is incorporated into hormone-related supplement formulations.

Enantiomeric specificity is a critical quality parameter for these products. Biotechnology and life sciences suppliers source it as a reference standard and biochemical reagent for receptor binding studies.

It is also utilized in neurological research models. In personal care formulations, it contributes moisture retention and pH stabilization in serums, creams, and targeted skin treatments.

Its chelating activity also supports preservation systems by sequestering trace metal ions that would otherwise degrade active ingredients. This ensures the long-term stability of complex chemical mixtures.

D-Aspartic acid is available as a white crystalline powder in research-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications. USP and high-purity grades are standard for procurement.

These grades typically maintain a purity level of ≥98–99% for pharmaceutical and biotech use. Bulk quantities are offered for industrial formulators, with smaller pack sizes available for laboratory use.

Quality control teams rely on these high standards for consistent results. Our supply chain ensures that all materials meet the rigorous demands of modern chemical and biological manufacturing processes.

name: Ceramide 3B
description:
Ceramide 3B (CAS 178436-06-1 ), also known as Ceramide NP and supplied under trade names such as Cytomide IIIa and Cytomide IIIb, is a synthetic sphingolipid that mirrors the ceramides naturally present in human skin.

It functions as a barrier-restoring and moisture-retention active in cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations targeting skin integrity. In prestige and mass-market skincare, it is incorporated into moisturizers and serums.

These products replenish the stratum corneum lipid matrix and reduce transepidermal water loss. Hair care formulators use it in conditioning treatments and leave-in products to smooth the cuticle surface and improve fiber manageability.

Pharmaceutical topical preparations, including emollient creams for eczema and dry skin conditions, rely on it to support skin barrier function alongside active drug ingredients. It is also used in color cosmetics and primers.

These applications benefit where improved skin adhesion and surface wetting are required. Ceramide 3B is typically supplied as a white to off-white powder or waxy solid for various industrial manufacturing processes.

Standard grades include cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade material, with purity specifications commonly at 95% or higher. Packaging ranges from small quantities for R&D sampling to bulk supply for commercial manufacturing.

name: Ethyl trisiloxane
description:
Ethyl trisiloxane (CAS 17861-60-8 ) is a short-chain silicone fluid used across industrial and personal care markets as a low-viscosity carrier, wetting agent, and surface modifier. Its siloxane backbone delivers fast spreading and substrate penetration where conventional solvents fall short.

In textile and leather processing, it improves active ingredient penetration and surface uniformity in finishing formulations. Automotive and metalworking lubricant formulators use it as a carrier fluid to enhance the deposition and spreading of functional additives on metal surfaces.

Personal care formulators incorporate it into leave-on and rinse-off products where lightweight, non-greasy skin feel and even distribution of actives are required. In paper treatment and release coating systems, it functions as a surface modifier to control wettability.

This material is highly effective at reducing interfacial tension across various substrates. Ethyl trisiloxane is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid and is available in technical grade for diverse industrial applications.

Packaging options typically range from small drums to IBC quantities depending on volume requirements. Buyers should confirm purity specifications and batch documentation directly with the supplier to ensure compliance with specific project needs.

Grade designations can vary between manufacturers, so technical data sheets should be reviewed carefully. This versatile silicone fluid remains a staple for formulators seeking high-performance spreading and carrier properties in modern chemical manufacturing.

name: Propylsilanetriyl triacetate
description:
Propylsilanetriyl triacetate (CAS 17865-07-5 ) is an organosilane monomer used as a crosslinking agent and surface modifier in silicone-based systems. On hydrolysis, it releases acetic acid and generates a reactive propylsilanetriol intermediate.

This intermediate bonds to inorganic substrates and polymer networks, functioning as a building block for moisture-cure formulations. It is utilized across several industrial sectors for silane-modified materials.

In adhesives, sealants, and elastomers, it acts as a crosslinker in acetoxy-cure silicone systems. This contributes to network formation and adhesion to glass, metal, and mineral surfaces for industrial use.

Coatings formulators use it to improve substrate wetting and durability on concrete, stone, and treated metals. These applications are common in architectural and protective coating projects requiring high performance.

In electronics, it supports encapsulant and potting compound formulations where controlled cure rates are critical. It ensures reliable surface bonding to circuit substrates during the manufacturing process.

The building and construction sector applies it in silicone sealants designed for glazing and façade work. It provides long-term adhesion under environmental stress for joint sealing in modern infrastructure.

Propylsilanetriyl triacetate is supplied as a liquid and is available in technical grade. Packaging options typically range from small drums to bulk quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes.

Buyers should confirm purity specifications and moisture-sensitive handling requirements with the supplier prior to ordering. Proper storage is essential to maintain the chemical integrity of this reactive monomer.

name: Trisodium ethylenediamine disuccinate
description:
Trisodium ethylenediamine disuccinate (CAS 178949-82-1 ), commercially available as NATRLQUEST E30 and ENVIOMET C140, is a biodegradable chelating agent derived from aspartic acid.

It binds and sequesters metal ions such as calcium, magnesium, iron, and copper across a broad pH range, allowing formulators to replace conventional chelants like EDTA in sensitive applications.

In personal care and cosmetics, it stabilizes formulations by deactivating trace metals that would otherwise degrade active ingredients or cause discoloration. This ensures product longevity and safety.

Water treatment operations use it to control scale and metal deposition in process water systems where biodegradability is a regulatory or compliance requirement. It is an effective green alternative.

Textile and leather processing relies on it to sequester hardness ions during dyeing and finishing, improving color consistency and process efficiency. It prevents unwanted mineral interference.

In agriculture, it functions as a micronutrient carrier, keeping iron and other trace elements soluble and bioavailable in fertilizer formulations. This promotes healthy crop growth and yield.

Trisodium ethylenediamine disuccinate is typically supplied as an aqueous solution, with NATRLQUEST E30 indicating a 30% active concentration. Technical and industrial grades are the primary forms.

Certain solution grades meet criteria for use in cosmetic and agricultural applications. Packaging options generally range from drums to intermediate bulk containers depending on volume requirements.

name: Zinc picolinate
description:
Zinc picolinate ( CAS 17949-65-4 ) is a zinc salt of picolinic acid used as a bioavailable zinc source in nutritional and functional product formulations. Its chelated structure supports efficient zinc delivery compared to inorganic zinc salts.

This makes it a preferred choice for supplement manufacturers and formulators targeting mineral fortification. In dietary supplements, it is used to deliver elemental zinc in capsule, tablet, and powder formats where absorption efficiency is a key criterion.

Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into topical products such as anti-acne creams and scalp treatments. In these applications, zinc's antimicrobial and sebum-regulating activity is the primary functional target for the formulation.

In animal nutrition, it serves as a chelated zinc source in premixes and compound feeds. It supports skin integrity, immune function, and reproductive performance in livestock across various agricultural sectors.

Pharmaceutical formulators use it in nutraceutical and OTC product development where a well-tolerated, organic zinc form is specified. The material is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder for industrial use.

Standard grades include food-grade and feed-grade specifications, with pharmaceutical-grade material available for regulated applications. Quality is maintained according to USP and FCC standards to ensure high purity.

name: Isobutyltriethoxysilane
description:
Isobutyltriethoxysilane (CAS 17980-47-1 ) is an alkylalkoxysilane used to impart hydrophobicity and improve adhesion at mineral and inorganic surfaces. It functions as a surface modifier and coupling agent across construction materials, coatings, and polymer systems.

In concrete and masonry protection, it penetrates porous substrates and bonds covalently to silicate surfaces. This process reduces water ingress without altering appearance, which is a key requirement for facade and infrastructure treatments.

Coatings formulators incorporate it as an adhesion promoter to improve bonding between organic binders and glass, metal, or mineral fillers. In sealant and elastomer systems, it acts as a crosslinker or co-crosslinker.

This chemical contributes to network formation and improves substrate adhesion in silicone and hybrid formulations. Plastics compounders use it to surface-treat mineral fillers such as silica or calcium carbonate.

Treating these fillers improves dispersion and mechanical performance in the final compound. Isobutyltriethoxysilane is supplied as a clear liquid, typically in drum and IBC quantities for industrial buyers.

It is available in technical grade, with purity specifications commonly at 97% or higher. Specialty grades meeting tighter purity thresholds are available for demanding coating and sealant applications.

name: 4-octylphenol
description:
4-Octylphenol (CAS 1806-26-4 ), also known as p-octylphenol, is an alkylphenol intermediate used across industrial chemistry as a monomer, surfactant precursor, and stabilizing agent.

Its primary commercial role is as a building block for ethoxylated nonionic surfactants and resin-based formulations. In textile and leather processing, it serves as a precursor to octylphenol ethoxylates.

These ethoxylates are used in scouring, dyeing auxiliaries, and emulsification baths. Lubricant and metalworking formulators incorporate it as an antioxidant component and additive intermediate to extend fluid service life.

In plastics and polymer manufacturing, it functions as a chain-terminating monomer and co-monomer in phenolic resins and polycarbonate-type systems. This ensures structural stability in various industrial polymers.

Water treatment chemical producers also use it as a starting material for dispersant and emulsifier synthesis. 4-Octylphenol is supplied as a liquid or low-melting solid, typically in bulk drums or IBC containers.

name: Bisdisulizole disodium
description:
Bisdisulizole disodium (CAS 180898-37-7 ), commercially known as Neo Heliopan AP and also identified as disodium phenyl dibenzimidazole tetrasulfonate, is a water-soluble UVA filter used in sun care and cosmetic formulations.

It provides broad-spectrum UV absorption in the UVA range, enabling formulators to meet increasingly stringent photoprotection standards. Sun care products including SPF lotions, sprays, and creams incorporate it as a primary UVA filter.

This allows manufacturers to achieve balanced UVA/UVB protection ratios required by EU and international regulations. Its water solubility makes it the preferred UVA filter in aqueous and hydrophilic formulations where oil-phase UV actives are unsuitable.

Daily skincare products such as moisturizers and foundations use it to deliver incidental UV protection without compromising texture or clarity. It is also used in combination sunscreen systems to boost the critical wavelength.

This helps products meet UVA protection factor (UVA-PF) labeling requirements. Bisdisulizole disodium is supplied as a white to off-white powder available in cosmetic-grade specification, the standard for personal care applications.

The material is compliant with EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex VI listings. Packaging typically ranges from kilogram-scale bags to bulk quantities suited for industrial formulators and large-scale manufacturing needs.

name: Dicetyldimethylammonium chloride
description:
Dicetyldimethylammonium chloride (CAS 1812-53-9 ), also known as Dicetyldimonium chloride and Quaternium-31, is a dialkyl quaternary ammonium compound used as a cationic surfactant and biocide.

Its dual long-chain structure delivers strong surface adsorption, making it effective for conditioning, antimicrobial action, and emulsion stabilization across personal care and industrial applications.

In hair care formulations, it functions as a primary conditioning agent in rinse-off conditioners and treatment masks, depositing onto negatively charged hair fiber to improve detangling and softness.

Textile and leather processors use it as a fabric softener and antistatic agent applied during finishing stages. In water treatment, it acts as a biocide targeting bacteria and algae.

Paper manufacturers apply it as a wet-strength additive and surface sizing agent to improve sheet performance. It is also utilized in hard surface disinfectants for institutional cleaning.

Dicetyldimethylammonium chloride is supplied as a paste, flake, or aqueous dispersion. Standard grades include cosmetic-grade and technical-grade material for various processing requirements.

Cosmetic-grade product meets purity specifications suitable for leave-on and rinse-off personal care formulations. Typical active concentrations in commercial supply range from 70% to 90% active content.

name: Tert-butyldimethylsilyl chloride
description:
Tert-butyldimethylsilyl chloride (CAS 18162-48-6 ), commonly referenced as TBDMSCl, is a silylating reagent used to introduce the TBDMS protecting group onto hydroxyl, carboxyl, and amine functionalities.

In pharmaceutical synthesis and research chemistry, it enables selective protection of reactive sites during multi-step synthesis sequences. In active pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturing, it protects alcohol and hydroxyl groups.

This allows subsequent reactions to proceed without unwanted side reactions at those sites. Nucleoside and nucleotide synthesis relies heavily on TBDMS protection to control regioselectivity during production.

This is a critical requirement in antiviral and oligonucleotide drug production. In electronics and semiconductor fabrication, it modifies silicon wafer surfaces and resists to control hydrophobicity and adhesion.

Biotechnology researchers also apply it in solid-phase synthesis of oligonucleotides. In these applications, precise protecting group chemistry directly determines the final product purity and overall yield.

TBDMSCl is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline solid. Standard commercial offerings include reagent-grade and high-purity grades, with purity specifications typically at 97–99%+ to meet industry demands.

These specifications are designed to meet the rigorous requirements of pharmaceutical and electronic applications. Packaging ranges from laboratory-scale quantities to multi-kilogram industrial lots for large-scale use.

Moisture-controlled packaging is standard due to its reactivity with atmospheric humidity. This ensures the stability and performance of the reagent throughout its shelf life in various storage conditions.

name: Iodofenphos
description:
Iodofenphos (CAS 18181-70-9 ), also marketed under the trade names Alfacron, Iodophos, and Nuvanol N, is an organophosphate insecticide developed for pest control in agricultural and veterinary settings.

It acts by inhibiting acetylcholinesterase in target insects, making it effective against a broad range of economically damaging pest species. In crop protection, it is applied to control soil-dwelling and foliar insect pests.

These pests often threaten yields in field and horticultural crops. It has been used in veterinary and livestock applications to manage ectoparasites such as flies, lice, and mites on cattle and other farm animals.

Public health and stored-product programs have employed it to control crawling insects and flies in grain storage and agricultural facilities. Formulated products have also been used in structural pest control.

These applications target cockroaches and other indoor insect pests in agricultural premises. The chemical is available as a technical-grade active ingredient and in various formulated forms for industrial use.

Common formulations include emulsifiable concentrates and wettable powders. Supply is primarily sourced through agrochemical manufacturers and distributors handling specialized organophosphate chemistry for global markets.

name: Copper glycinate
description:
Copper glycinate (CAS 18253-80-0 ), also known as cupric glycinate hydrate, is a chelated copper-amino acid complex used as a bioavailable copper source across nutritional, agricultural, and pharmaceutical applications.

Its chelated form improves copper absorption compared to inorganic copper salts, making it a preferred choice for formulators targeting efficient mineral delivery in various industrial sectors.

In dietary supplements and functional foods, it is used to fortify products where copper deficiency correction or antioxidant enzyme support is the primary formulation goal for the end user.

Animal feed manufacturers incorporate it as an organic trace mineral source, particularly in poultry, swine, and aquaculture feeds where improved bioavailability translates to better growth outcomes.

Pharmaceutical formulators use it in mineral supplement preparations where chelated copper is specified for enhanced gastrointestinal tolerance and superior metabolic absorption rates in patients.

In food fortification, it serves as a copper source in products requiring clean-label or amino acid-chelated mineral declarations, meeting strict regulatory requirements for food safety.

The product is typically supplied as a crystalline powder or fine solid. It is available in feed-grade and nutritional supplement grades, with specifications aligned to industry standards.

Buyers should confirm purity levels and copper content per lot, as these vary by manufacturer. Quality may be verified against standards such as FCC or USP depending on the grade.

name: Tin Oxide
description:
Tin Oxide (CAS 18282-10-5 ), also known as Stannic oxide, is an inorganic compound used industrially as a catalyst, conductive coating material, and functional ceramic additive.

It is a core material in electronics manufacturing and surface treatment processes where controlled electrical conductivity or catalytic activity is required for high-performance industrial applications.

In electronics, it is used to produce transparent conductive coatings on glass and display substrates, enabling touch screens, solar panels, and low-emissivity window films for modern buildings.

As a catalyst or catalyst precursor, it supports oxidation reactions in industrial gas sensing and exhaust treatment systems. It plays a vital role in environmental monitoring and emission control.

In home care and industrial cleaning formulations, it functions as a mild abrasive and polishing agent in metal and glass finishing compounds. It provides a smooth surface finish without damage.

Ceramic and glass manufacturers incorporate it to achieve opacity, surface hardness, and specific refractive properties in glazes and specialty optical glass. It is essential for high-quality ceramics.

This material is supplied as a fine white powder in varying particle size distributions suited to coating, ceramic, or catalytic applications. Standard grades include technical and high-purity specifications.

Electronic and catalyst grades are available for more demanding processing requirements. Packaging typically ranges from kilogram-scale bags to bulk quantities depending on the specific application volume.

name: Ascorbyl tetraisopalmitate
description:
Ascorbyl tetraisopalmitate (CAS 183476-82-6 ), also known as tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate and commercially abbreviated as VC-IP, is a highly lipophilic ester form of Vitamin C used in cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations.

Unlike water-soluble ascorbic acid, it disperses readily in oils and emollients, enabling stable delivery of Vitamin C into lipid-rich skin layers. This oil-solubility makes it a preferred active for formulators.

It is ideal for those who need oxidation-resistant Vitamin C performance in anhydrous or low-water systems. In premium skincare, VC-IP is incorporated into facial serums, sunscreens, and anti-aging creams.

It provides antioxidant protection and supports an even skin tone without the instability issues common to aqueous Vitamin C formats. Oil-based and waterless formulations use it as a stable active ingredient.

Cleansing balms, facial oils, and lip treatments use it to remain effective throughout shelf life. Pharmaceutical topical preparations targeting skin oxidative stress also source VC-IP for its compatibility.

Its humectant contribution supports moisture retention in emollient-rich leave-on products. Ascorbyl tetraisopalmitate is supplied as a pale yellow to yellow viscous liquid or oil for industrial use.

It is available in cosmetic-grade specification, the standard form for personal care and topical pharmaceutical applications. Purity grades of 97% and above are commonly offered for formulation use.

description:
2-Ethylhexyl 2,3,4,5-tetrabromobenzoate (CAS 183658-27-7 ), commonly referenced in the market as EH-TBB or TBB, is a brominated aromatic ester used as a non-polymeric flame retardant.

It functions by interrupting combustion in polymer matrices, helping end products meet fire safety standards. In flexible polyurethane foam, EH-TBB is a primary component of next-generation flame retardant blends.

These blends were developed as alternatives to legacy brominated compounds, particularly in furniture and bedding applications. Textile back-coating formulations incorporate it to achieve flame resistance.

This is particularly useful in upholstery fabrics and curtains without compromising flexibility. In plastics processing, it is compounded into soft PVC and engineering resins where halogenated flame retardancy is required.

Leather and paper treatments also utilize TBB where surface-applied flame retardant finishes must meet specific regulatory or commercial fire standards. It is supplied as a liquid or low-viscosity fluid.

This physical state makes it suitable for direct blending into foam systems and coating formulations. It is available in technical grade, with purity specifications typically confirmed by bromine content and ester assay.

Bulk and drummed packaging options are standard for industrial supply chains. This ensures efficient logistics and handling for large-scale manufacturing operations across various chemical sectors.

name: Ethacridine lactate
description:
Ethacridine lactate (CAS 1837-57-6 ), commercially recognized as Rivanol and Acrinol, is an antiseptic acridine derivative used in pharmaceutical and healthcare manufacturing. It functions as a topical antimicrobial and preservative active.

The compound has established use in wound care and gynecological preparations. In topical pharmaceutical formulations, it is incorporated into wound-cleansing solutions, antiseptic creams, and gauze dressings targeting bacterial contamination.

These applications focus on minor wounds and ulcers. Gynecological applications include its use in vaginal antiseptic preparations and, in some markets, as an active in labor-induction protocols under clinical supervision.

As a preservative active in pharmaceutical manufacturing, it provides antimicrobial protection in aqueous formulations where conventional preservatives are unsuitable. This makes it a versatile component for specialized medicine.

Contract manufacturers and compounding pharmacies sourcing for Eastern European, Asian, and Latin American markets represent a significant procurement base. Rivanol-branded products retain a strong market presence in these regions.

name: Chlorhexidine gluconate
description:
Chlorhexidine gluconate (CAS 18472-51-0 ), commonly abbreviated as CHG and also known as chlorhexidine digluconate, is a broad-spectrum antimicrobial agent used across pharmaceutical and personal care manufacturing.

It delivers sustained bactericidal and antifungal activity, making it a preferred active ingredient in antiseptic and preservative formulations. In healthcare settings, CHG is the active ingredient in surgical scrubs.

It is used in pre-operative skin preparation products and wound care formulations. Oral care products such as prescription-strength mouth rinses rely on CHG for its substantive binding to oral mucosa.

This provides prolonged antimicrobial action against plaque-forming bacteria. Personal care formulators incorporate it into hand sanitizers, intimate hygiene products, and medicated cleansers.

It is used where preservative efficacy and skin compatibility are both required. It also functions as a preservative in ophthalmic solutions and contact lens care products at low concentrations.

Chlorhexidine gluconate is supplied primarily as an aqueous solution, with 20% and 5% concentrations being the most common commercial forms. Pharmaceutical-grade material is available to USP standards.

The material is also available to BP and Ph. Eur. specifications. Bulk supply is standard for industrial and pharmaceutical buyers, with solution concentration being a key procurement parameter.

Grade specification remains a critical factor for buyers in the chemical industry. These standards ensure the material meets the rigorous safety requirements for medical and consumer applications.

name: Strontium hydroxide
description:
Strontium hydroxide (CAS 18480-07-4 ) is a strong inorganic base used industrially for pH adjustment, neutralization, and as a strontium source in chemical synthesis. It is available in both anhydrous and octahydrate forms.

Each form is suited to different processing requirements across various sectors. In water treatment, it neutralizes acidic effluents and precipitates heavy metal contaminants, supporting compliance with discharge standards.

Electronics manufacturers use it in the production of strontium-based compounds for cathode ray tube glass and specialty ceramic formulations. It also serves as a precursor in synthesizing strontium salts.

These salts include strontium carbonate and strontium nitrate, which are used in pyrotechnics and optical glass production. Sugar refining has historically used the compound to separate sucrose from molasses.

This process occurs through strontianite precipitation, though this application is now limited. The product is supplied as a white powder or crystalline solid in both anhydrous and octahydrate forms.

Technical grade is the standard commercial specification for industrial and synthesis applications. Packaging typically ranges from small drums to bulk quantities for large-scale manufacturing needs.

Purity levels are commonly specified at 95% or higher depending on end-use requirements. This ensures consistent performance in chemical reactions and industrial processes requiring high-quality alkaline sources.

name: Undecanedioic acid
description:
Undecanedioic acid (CAS 1852-04-6 ), also known as hendecanedioic acid, is an eleven-carbon aliphatic dicarboxylic acid used as a bifunctional building block across polymer chemistry and industrial formulation.

Its two reactive carboxylic end groups make it a reliable monomer for synthesizing specialty polyamides, polyesters, and ester-based intermediates for various high-performance applications.

In coatings and adhesives, it serves as a chain extender or crosslinker to tune flexibility, adhesion, and film durability in polyester and polyamide resin systems used in demanding environments.

Lubricant formulators use it to produce diester and complex ester base fluids with improved thermal stability and low-temperature performance for high-specification metalworking and industrial oils.

Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into emollients and rheology modifiers, where its ester derivatives contribute to skin-feel, emulsion stability, and texture in premium creams and lotions.

In sealant and elastomer production, it functions as a reactive intermediate that adjusts chain length and mechanical properties in cured polymer networks to meet specific industrial requirements.

Undecanedioic acid is supplied as a white crystalline powder or flake. Technical grade is the standard commercial form, with purity levels typically at 98% or higher for most industrial uses.

High-purity grades are available for specialty polymer and personal care applications where tighter specifications are required to ensure the quality and consistency of the final chemical product.

name: N-Butoxymethylacrylamide
description:
N-Butoxymethylacrylamide (CAS 1852-16-0 ) is a reactive acrylamide monomer used in the synthesis of crosslinkable polymers and copolymer systems. The butoxymethyl group enables thermally activated self-crosslinking.

This functionality allows formulators to build durable, cured networks without external crosslinker additions. In textile and leather finishing, it is incorporated into coating formulations to improve wash fastness.

It also enhances abrasion resistance and substrate adhesion after curing. Paper manufacturers use it to develop wet-strength resins and surface sizing agents where controlled crosslink density is critical to performance.

In printing and packaging, it functions as a reactive monomer in UV- or heat-curable binder systems. This contributes to ink and coating durability on demanding substrates during the manufacturing process.

Plastics and polymer producers use it as a comonomer to introduce latent crosslinking functionality into acrylic dispersions. It is also highly effective when utilized in various emulsion polymer applications.

N-Butoxymethylacrylamide is supplied as a liquid, typically at high purity grades suited for polymerization applications. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering for industrial chemical processes.

Specifications focus on monomer purity, inhibitor content, and residual butanol levels relevant to copolymerization performance. Packaging ranges from small drums to bulk quantities depending on production volumes.

name: Magnesium glutamate
description:
Magnesium glutamate (CAS 18543-68-5 ), also known by its food additive designation E625 , is the magnesium salt of glutamic acid used as a flavor enhancer in food manufacturing.

It delivers umami taste amplification while simultaneously contributing a bioavailable magnesium source, making it relevant across both food formulation and nutritional supplement development.

In processed and savory food production, E625 enhances meaty, broth-like flavor profiles in soups, sauces, seasonings, and snack coatings. This often allows sodium reduction without sacrificing taste intensity.

Nutritional supplement formulators incorporate it as a mineral source where glutamate-bound magnesium offers favorable absorption characteristics compared to inorganic magnesium salts.

In pharmaceutical oral dosage forms, it functions as an excipient or active mineral component in magnesium supplementation products targeting dietary deficiency.

Functional food and sports nutrition manufacturers use it in powdered drink mixes and meal replacements where both flavor balance and mineral fortification are formulation objectives.

Magnesium glutamate is supplied as a white crystalline powder. Food-grade material conforming to E625 additive specifications is the primary commercial form available to buyers.

This helps manufacturers control cure rates in latex and compounded rubber systems. Food and beverage producers use it as an antimicrobial preservative to extend shelf life in acidic products.

In personal care and cosmetic formulations, it contributes to preservation and pH regulation, particularly in rinse-off and leave-on products targeting microbial stability for long-term storage.

Pharmaceutical manufacturers incorporate it as a buffering agent and preservative in topical and oral preparations requiring controlled acidity. It is supplied as a white crystalline powder or granules.

name: Tribehenin
description:
Tribehenin (CAS 18641-57-1 ), also known as Glyceryl Tribehenate and commercially as Compritol 888, is a glycerol triester of behenic acid used across pharmaceutical, food, and cosmetic manufacturing.

It functions primarily as a lipid-based excipient and structuring agent, controlling texture, release behavior, and consistency in solid and semi-solid formulations for various industrial applications.

In pharmaceutical tablet manufacturing, it acts as a hydrophobic matrix former for extended-release solid dosage forms, slowing active ingredient dissolution without requiring polymer coatings.

Cosmetic formulators use it to build structure in stick products, such as lipsticks, deodorant bars, and solid balms, where it controls hardness and modifies the waxy feel on application.

In food-grade applications, it functions as a fat replacer and bloom inhibitor in confectionery coatings and chocolate-based products, improving shelf stability and overall product quality.

It also serves as a lubricant and binder in direct compression tableting, reducing die friction and improving tablet integrity during the high-speed manufacturing process.

Tribehenin is supplied as a white to off-white waxy powder or flakes. It is available in pharmaceutical-grade specifications, with Compritol 888 ATO being the most recognized commercial grade.

This material is used in regulated drug product manufacturing, and food-grade material is also available for confectionery and nutraceutical applications requiring high purity standards.

name: Bemotrizinol
description:
Bemotrizinol (CAS 187393-00-6 ), commercially recognized as Tinosorb S and abbreviated as BEMT, is a high-performance broadband UV absorber used in sun care and photoprotection formulations.

It provides dual UVA/UVB coverage and is valued for its photostability, making it a preferred active for formulators building high-SPF systems. In sun care products, it is used as a primary UV filter.

It is frequently found in sunscreens, day creams, and SPF-boosting formulations, often combined with other organic filters to optimize protection profiles. Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into leave-on products.

These include facial moisturizers and foundations where long-term photostability of the formula is critical. In coatings and polymer systems, it functions as a UV stabilizer to prevent photodegradation of substrates.

This application extends the service life of exterior paints, varnishes, and plastic components. Adhesives and sealant formulations exposed to outdoor conditions also use the material to maintain bond integrity.

Bemotrizinol is supplied as a fine powder and as pre-dispersed liquid suspensions suited for emulsion-based cosmetic systems. Standard cosmetic-grade specifications are the norm for personal care supply.

This versatility reduces the need for multiple components in complex chemical systems. In plastics and polymer systems, it is incorporated into resins and coatings to impart flame retardancy while simultaneously improving substrate flexibility.

This specific combination reduces the overall additive load in finished compounds. Home care and industrial cleaning formulations use it as a functional solvent or co-solvent component where phosphonate chemistry supports soil removal and formulation stability.

It is also evaluated as a reactive intermediate or modifier in specialty polymer synthesis. Here, the phosphonate group can be integrated into the polymer backbone for durable flame retardant performance that lasts the life of the product.

Industrial coating systems targeting fire-resistance standards benefit from its compatibility with a range of resin types. This compatibility ensures that the structural integrity of the coating remains intact while providing essential safety features.

description:
1-Ethyl-3-(3-dimethylaminopropyl)carbodiimide (CAS 1892-57-5 ), commonly known as EDC or EDCI, is a water-soluble carbodiimide coupling reagent used to form stable amide and ester bonds.

In industry, it functions as a zero-length crosslinker, activating carboxylic acids for conjugation without becoming part of the final bond. This makes it essential for complex chemical synthesis.

EDC is the reagent of choice for bioconjugation workflows, including antibody-antigen coupling, protein-to-surface immobilization, and diagnostic assay development. It ensures high efficiency in aqueous environments.

In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it supports peptide synthesis and the preparation of drug-protein conjugates where clean, traceable crosslinking chemistry is required for regulatory compliance.

Personal care formulators use it to crosslink hyaluronic acid and other polysaccharides in dermal filler and hydrogel systems. It provides the structural integrity needed for advanced cosmetic applications.

Research-scale and GMP production of biosensors, lateral flow devices, and conjugate vaccines also rely on EDC as a primary activation agent. Its versatility spans across multiple biotech sectors.

EDC is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder, with the hydrochloride salt form being the dominant commercial grade due to its superior stability under ambient storage conditions.

It is available in research quantities through to multi-kilogram lots, with pharmaceutical-grade material meeting specifications relevant to GMP bioconjugation processes and industrial standards.

name: Magnesium hexafluorosilicate
description:
Magnesium hexafluorosilicate (CAS 18972-56-0 ), also known as magnesium fluorosilicate, is an inorganic fluorosilicate salt used industrially as a surface hardening agent and biocidal preservative.

It is applied to porous substrates to improve durability, resist biological degradation, and modify surface chemistry across construction, textile, and water treatment processes.

In concrete and masonry treatment, it reacts with calcium hydroxide in cured cement to densify and harden surface layers, extending the service life of floors, pavements, and structural elements.

Textile and leather processors use it as a fixing and preservation agent, improving resistance to microbial attack in treated fabrics and hides during various stages of production.

In paper manufacturing, it functions as a surface modifier that improves wet strength and resistance to biological deterioration during storage or processing for industrial use.

Water treatment operations employ it as a fluoridating and conditioning agent in specific municipal and industrial treatment programs to ensure proper chemical balance and safety.

The product is supplied as a white crystalline powder or in aqueous solution, with solution concentrations typically ranging from 20% to 30% depending on the specific requirements.

The product is available in Technical grade for standard commercial specification. Purity levels and packaging formats vary by application, with bulk supply available for large-scale procurement.

name: 4-butylresorcinol
description:
4-Butylresorcinol (CAS 18979-61-8 ), commercially recognized as Rucinol, is a synthetic depigmentation active used in cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations. It inhibits tyrosinase and peroxidase enzymes involved in melanin synthesis.

This makes it a targeted ingredient for skin-brightening and hyperpigmentation correction products. In premium skincare, it is formulated into serums, creams, and spot treatments targeting melasma and age spots.

It is often used at concentrations between 0.1% and 1% for post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. Pharmaceutical topical preparations use it as an active ingredient in prescription and OTC depigmenting products.

Regulatory-grade purity is required for these applications to ensure safety and efficacy. Its antioxidant activity also supports use as a stabilizer in formulations where oxidative degradation is a concern.

Some specialty formulations incorporate it for its mild preservative-boosting effect alongside primary systems. 4-Butylresorcinol is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder for industrial use.

It is available in cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications. High-purity grades, typically ≥98% or ≥99% by HPLC, are standard for active cosmetic ingredient supply chains.

Packaging ranges from small quantities for R&D sampling to kilogram-scale lots for commercial batches. This ensures flexibility for both laboratory development and large-scale manufacturing needs.

name: Monosodium citrate
description:
Monosodium citrate ( CAS 18996-35-5 ), also known as Sodium dihydrogen citrate and designated E331i , is the monobasic sodium salt of citric acid used across food, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications.

It functions primarily as a pH buffer, acidulant, and chelating agent, offering precise control over acidity in formulations where stronger acidification or tighter buffering capacity is required than trisodium citrate provides.

In food and beverage manufacturing, it acidulates and buffers carbonated drinks, fruit preparations, and dairy-based products where controlled tartness and stability are priorities for the final product.

Pharmaceutical formulators use it to establish and maintain pH in oral solutions, effervescent tablets, and topical preparations. In personal care, it adjusts pH in creams, gels, and cleansing products.

It also works by sequestering metal ions that would otherwise destabilize the formulation. Water treatment applications rely on its chelating properties to complex calcium and magnesium ions effectively.

This process prevents scale formation in process systems and industrial equipment. Monosodium citrate is supplied as a white crystalline powder or granule depending on the specific application requirements.

Standard grades include food-grade meeting FCC specifications and pharmaceutical-grade conforming to USP and Ph. Eur. monographs. Technical grade is available for industrial and water treatment use.

These industrial grades are suitable where food or pharma compliance is not required. The material provides consistent performance across a wide range of chemical and manufacturing environments.

name: Butyloctyl salicylate
description:
Butyloctyl salicylate (CAS 190085-41-7 ), sold commercially as Hallbrite BHB, is a branched-chain ester used in personal care and cosmetic formulations. It functions as a UV-absorbing emollient and solubilizer.

This ingredient helps formulators dissolve and stabilize other sunscreen actives while contributing skin-feel properties. In sunscreen and SPF formulations, it solubilizes oil-soluble UV filters such as avobenzone and octinoxate.

By improving their photostability and enabling higher active loadings, it enhances product performance. Color cosmetics manufacturers use it as a carrier and spreading agent in foundations, lip products, and pressed powders.

Its low viscosity aids pigment dispersion across various cosmetic applications. It also appears in skincare emulsions such as serums, moisturizers, and after-sun products where it replaces heavier esters.

This substitution helps achieve a lighter, non-greasy skin feel without compromising emulsion stability. The product is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid suitable for direct incorporation into oil phases.

It is available in cosmetic-grade specification, the standard for personal care and OTC topical applications. Bulk supply is typical in drums and intermediate bulk containers for industrial use.

Sample quantities are available for formulation development and testing purposes. This versatile ester remains a staple for manufacturers seeking to optimize the texture and efficacy of sun care products.

name: Potassium cetyl phosphate
description:
Potassium cetyl phosphate ( CAS 19035-79-1 ), also known as cetyl potassium phosphate, is an anionic phosphate ester salt used as an emulsifier and surfactant in personal care and pharmaceutical formulations.

It stabilizes oil-in-water emulsions and modifies surface behavior in topical systems where compatibility with skin and active ingredients is a priority. In cosmetic creams and lotions, it functions as the primary emulsifying agent.

This material produces stable, elegant emulsions that support a broad range of oil phases and active loads. Pharmaceutical topical formulations, including medicated creams and dermal drug delivery bases, rely on it for consistent emulsion structure.

It ensures controlled release behavior and also acts as a wetting and dispersing agent in suspensions where uniform particle distribution is critical to product performance. Sunscreen formulations benefit from its ability to stabilize UV filter dispersions.

While maintaining skin feel and formulation aesthetics, it provides reliable stability across various temperatures. Potassium cetyl phosphate is supplied as a white to off-white powder or paste, depending on the manufacturer and grade.

Both cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade material are available, with pharmaceutical supply typically meeting USP or Ph. Eur. purity standards. Packaging ranges from small quantities for R&D to bulk industrial supply for commercial production.

name: Disodium 1-dodecyl sulfosuccinate
description:
Disodium 1-dodecyl sulfosuccinate (CAS 19040-44-9 ), also known as Disodium 1-lauryl sulfosuccinate, is an anionic surfactant used across personal care, textile, and industrial cleaning applications.

It functions as a foaming agent, emulsifier, and detergent active, delivering surface activity across a range of formulation and process conditions. In personal care, it acts as a mild cleansing and foaming base.

It is frequently used in shampoos, body washes, and facial cleansers where reduced irritation profiles are a formulation priority. Textile and leather processors use it to improve wetting and penetration during dyeing.

The chemical is also utilized during scouring and finishing operations. In paper manufacturing, it supports fiber dispersion and surface treatment processes to ensure high-quality output and consistency.

Industrial cleaning formulations incorporate it as a degreasing and emulsifying active in hard surface cleaners and industrial degreasers. It is typically supplied as an aqueous solution for ease of use.

Active content concentrations commonly range from 35% to 40%. Both technical-grade and cosmetic-grade material are available to meet industrial process requirements or personal care compliance standards.

Buyers should confirm active content, pH, and sodium sulfate levels when evaluating grades for sensitive formulation work. This ensures the material meets the necessary performance and safety benchmarks.

name: Cetyl dimethicone
description:
Cetyl dimethicone (CAS 191044-49-2 ) is a silicone-modified long-chain fatty alcohol used primarily as an emulsifier and skin-conditioning agent in cosmetic and personal care formulations.

By combining silicone fluidity with a cetyl hydrophobic tail, it enables stable water-in-silicone emulsions that conventional emulsifiers cannot readily achieve for industrial use.

Formulators and industrial buyers source it for its dual function in surface modification and moisture retention across multiple end-use markets including skin care and color cosmetics.

It stabilizes water-in-silicone emulsion systems in foundations, sunscreens, and moisturizers, delivering a lightweight, non-greasy skin feel for high-end consumer products.

Hair care formulators use it in conditioning treatments and serums to improve surface wetting and deposit silicone actives more uniformly along the hair shaft for better results.

In textile finishing, it functions as a softening and surface-modification agent, improving fabric hand and water repellency while enhancing the overall durability of the treated material.

Coating and sealant manufacturers incorporate it to enhance substrate wetting and compatibility between silicone matrices and polar components in various industrial applications.

Cetyl dimethicone is typically supplied as a clear to pale yellow viscous liquid available in cosmetic-grade specifications and technical grades for bulk procurement in drums or IBCs.

name: Atrazine
description:
Atrazine (CAS 1912-24-9 ) is a selective triazine herbicide used in commercial agriculture to control broadleaf and grassy weeds. Marketed under trade names including Weedex and Primatol A, it remains one of the most established herbicides.

This chemical is utilized in pre- and post-emergent crop protection programs globally. It is primarily applied in maize and sorghum cultivation, where it controls a broad spectrum of annual weeds without damaging the crop.

In sugarcane production, it is used as a soil-applied treatment to suppress weed competition during the critical early growth phase. Formulators incorporate it into suspension concentrates and wettable powder products.

The product is suitable for both ground and aerial application programs. It also serves as an active ingredient in tank-mix combinations with other herbicides to extend weed control spectrum and manage resistance.

The material is supplied as a technical-grade active ingredient, typically as a white crystalline powder at 95–97% purity for formulation use. Finished formulations are available as suspension concentrates and powders.

These products are offered at standardized active concentrations to meet industrial requirements. Technical material is traded in bulk quantities, with supply sourced primarily from manufacturers in China and India.

name: Deoxynojirimycin
description:
Deoxynojirimycin (CAS 19130-96-2 ), also known as Moranolin and abbreviated as 1-DNJ, is a naturally derived iminosugar extracted primarily from mulberry leaf. It functions as an alpha-glucosidase inhibitor.

This makes it a target active ingredient for pharmaceutical and cosmetic formulators seeking carbohydrate-metabolism modulation at the ingredient level. In pharmaceutical development, it is used as an active reference compound.

It serves as an API precursor in research targeting type 2 diabetes and glycosidase-related enzyme disorders. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into anti-aging and skin-brightening formulations for enzyme-inhibitory activity.

This activity is linked to melanogenesis pathway interference. Mulberry-derived standardized extracts containing quantified 1-DNJ concentrations are supplied to nutraceutical manufacturers for blood sugar management supplement formulations.

It also serves as a biochemical tool compound in glycobiology research, supporting assay development and enzyme characterization workflows. The material is available as a white to off-white crystalline powder.

It is offered in both isolated high-purity form and as standardized mulberry leaf extract with defined 1-DNJ content. Pharmaceutical and research-grade specifications are the most commonly supplied to the industry.

Purity levels typically range from 98% upward for isolated material. Extract grades are characterized by 1-DNJ assay percentage rather than absolute purity, and buyers should confirm standardization methods when sourcing.

Contact us for supply of Deoxynojirimycin

name: Potassium adipate
description:
Potassium adipate (CAS 19147-16-1 ), also known as Dipotassium adipate and approved as E357 in the EU, is the dipotassium salt of adipic acid used as a buffering agent and acidulant.

It regulates pH and contributes mild acidity in formulations where sodium-reduced or potassium-based alternatives to common acidulants are preferred for specific industrial and food applications.

In food manufacturing, E357 functions as a pH buffer and flavoring acidulant in low-sodium product lines, including processed foods and beverages where potassium-based mineral salts are specified.

Pharmaceutical formulators use it as a buffering excipient in oral preparations requiring controlled acidity and potassium content. It ensures stability and consistency in various medicinal formulations.

In animal feed applications, it supports mineral supplementation and pH management in compound feed formulations. Agricultural uses include its incorporation into nutrient solutions and fertilizer blends.

As a potassium source compatible with liquid formulation systems, it provides essential nutrients. Potassium adipate is supplied as a white crystalline powder or granules for easy handling.

Food-grade material is available meeting E357 specifications under EU food additive regulations. Technical-grade material is also offered for non-food industrial applications and chemical processing.

Bulk quantities are typically available in bags or fiber drums. Documentation supporting food and feed compliance is available on request to ensure full regulatory adherence for your supply chain.

name: Dicamba
description:
Dicamba (CAS 1918-00-9 ), also known as MDBA, is a selective benzoic acid herbicide used in commercial agriculture to control broadleaf weeds and woody plants. It functions by mimicking natural plant growth hormones.

This mechanism causes uncontrolled growth in susceptible species while leaving established grasses largely unaffected. Dicamba is applied in cereal grain crops including wheat, corn, and sorghum to suppress persistent weeds.

It is particularly effective against kochia, bindweed, and thistle that resist other herbicide classes. In dicamba-tolerant soybean and cotton programs, it serves as the active ingredient in pre-emergent formulations.

These products are designed for genetically modified crop systems. Turf management and non-crop land applications use the chemical to clear rights-of-way, pastures, and rangeland of invasive broadleaf vegetation.

It is also incorporated into combination herbicide products alongside active ingredients such as 2,4-D to broaden weed control spectrum. The product is supplied as a technical-grade acid and as formulated salts.

Most commonly, the dimethylamine and diglycolamine salt forms are used, which offer improved volatility profiles for field use. Technical material is available in bulk quantities for formulation by manufacturers.

Standard purity for technical grade typically falls at 97% or above, with specifications aligned to FAO/WHO quality standards. This ensures high performance and reliability for large-scale agricultural applications.

name: Acrylates/vinyl isodecanoate crosspolymer
description:
Acrylates/vinyl isodecanoate crosspolymer (CAS 191808-02-3 ), commercially available as Stabylen 30, is a crosslinked acrylic polymer used to control viscosity and texture in aqueous and emulsion-based formulations.

It functions as a rheology modifier and thickener, enabling formulators to achieve stable, aesthetically refined products across personal care and industrial applications. In skin care and hair care formulations, it builds gel structure.

It suspends active ingredients without leaving heavy residue, making it suitable for lightweight lotions, serums, and styling gels. Coating formulators use it to adjust flow and leveling behavior in waterborne systems.

This improves application performance and film uniformity. In home care products such as liquid detergents and surface cleaners, it provides the viscosity profile needed for controlled dispensing and cling on vertical surfaces.

Adhesive and sealant manufacturers incorporate it to tune rheological behavior during processing and application. Acrylates/vinyl isodecanoate crosspolymer is typically supplied as a liquid dispersion or gel-form concentrate.

It is available in cosmetic-grade specifications aligned with INCI and international regulatory standards for personal care use. Technical-grade supply is also available for industrial coatings, cleaning, and adhesive applications.

name: Propylene glycol dibenzoate
description:
Propylene glycol dibenzoate (CAS 19224-26-1 ), also recognized by its FEMA 3419 designation, is a benzoate ester plasticizer and solvent used across polymer and coating systems.

It functions as a low-volatility plasticizer and coalescent, improving flexibility and film formation in a range of industrial formulations. In PVC and vinyl compounding, it delivers efficient plasticization.

The material offers good compatibility, providing a phthalate-free alternative for flexible film, flooring, and profile applications. Coating formulators use it as a coalescent agent in waterborne systems.

It aids film formation without the high VOC burden of conventional solvents. In adhesives and sealants, it improves tack, flexibility, and substrate wetting across both solvent-borne and emulsion-based systems.

Printing ink manufacturers incorporate it as a solvent-carrier to control viscosity and resin compatibility in packaging ink formulations. This versatility makes it a staple in modern chemical manufacturing.

Propylene glycol dibenzoate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid. It is available in technical grade, with supply typically in drums and IBC totes for industrial volumes.

Buyers should confirm purity specifications and lot documentation directly with the supplier, as grade designations vary by manufacturer. Proper storage ensures the stability of the chemical properties over time.

name: Calcium glutamate
description:
Calcium glutamate ( CAS 19238-49-4 ) is the calcium salt of glutamic acid, supplying both a bioavailable calcium source and glutamate functionality in a single ingredient. It functions as a flavor enhancer and acidulant in food systems.

The compound also serves as a mineral supplement carrier in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulations. In processed foods, it delivers umami taste enhancement while contributing calcium fortification for clean-label projects.

Nutraceutical and dietary supplement manufacturers use it to provide elemental calcium in tablet, capsule, and powder formats. Amino acid-chelated minerals are often preferred in these applications for their specific absorption profiles.

In pharmaceutical applications, it serves as a mineral source in oral rehydration and clinical nutrition products. This is particularly useful where precise calcium dosing is required for patient health and recovery protocols.

Food manufacturers developing low-sodium flavor systems also evaluate it as a partial replacement for monosodium glutamate. This allows for maintaining a savory taste profile without the addition of extra sodium to the final product.

Calcium glutamate is supplied as a white crystalline powder. Food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade material is available, with buyers typically specifying purity against in-house or compendial standards like FCC or USP .

Material can also be sourced to meet Ph.Eur. , BP , EP , or ACS specifications depending on the end application. Packaging options commonly include multi-kilogram bags and fiber drums for production.

These formats are suited to both pilot-scale and commercial production volumes. The versatility of the ingredient makes it a staple for formulators looking for high-quality mineral salts and flavor enhancers.

name: tert-butyl monoperoxymaleate
description:
Tert-butyl monoperoxymaleate (CAS 1931-62-0 ) is an organic peroxide used as a radical source in polymer manufacturing and curing systems. It delivers controlled radical generation at moderate temperatures, making it suitable for initiating polymerization.

This chemical is effective for cross-linking reactions across multiple substrate types. In plastics and polymer production, it initiates free-radical polymerization of vinyl and acrylic monomers, supporting the manufacture of resins and thermoplastic compounds.

Coating formulators use it as a curing agent in unsaturated polyester and acrylic systems where controlled crosslink density affects final film performance. It ensures that the resulting coatings meet specific durability and finish requirements.

In adhesive and sealant formulations, it supports room- or elevated-temperature cure schedules for structural bonding applications. This versatility allows manufacturers to tailor their production processes to specific environmental conditions.

Elastomer producers apply it as a cross-linking initiator to achieve defined network density in rubber compounds and sealant matrices. This process is critical for maintaining the structural integrity and elasticity of the final rubber products.

Tert-butyl monoperoxymaleate is typically supplied as a liquid or solution, often phlegmatized in a plasticizer or solvent to meet transport and handling requirements. This stabilization is necessary for the safe management of organic peroxides.

Technical-grade material is the standard commercial offering, with active oxygen content used as the primary specification parameter. Packaging and concentration levels vary by supplier to comply with regulatory classification thresholds.

These standards ensure that the peroxide transport remains safe and efficient across international borders. Proper storage and handling are essential to maintain the chemical stability and performance of the product over time.

name: Tartrazine
description:
Tartrazine (CAS 1934-21-0 ), also known as E102 , Yellow 5, and Acid Yellow 23, is a synthetic lemon-yellow azo dye used to impart color across food, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications.

It delivers consistent, bright yellow hues with strong tinctorial strength, making it a go-to colorant where reliable batch-to-batch color matching is required for various manufacturing processes.

In food and beverage manufacturing, it colors products such as soft drinks, confectionery, snack coatings, and instant desserts to achieve yellow and green shades when blended with other dyes.

Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it to color tablet coatings, capsule shells, and oral liquid formulations for product differentiation and brand identification across diverse medical product lines.

Personal care and cosmetic formulators incorporate it into shampoos, bath products, and soaps where a stable, water-soluble yellow colorant is needed for consistent aesthetic appeal.

In textile and paper dyeing, it is applied to achieve uniform yellow shades on cellulose substrates and in paper pulp coloring processes for high-quality industrial output.

The material is supplied as a fine orange-yellow powder, typically as the sodium salt form. Food-grade material is available to FCC and E102 specifications for global compliance.

Aluminum lake versions are offered for oil-dispersible applications. Pharmaceutical-grade supply conforming to USP and BP standards is also commercially available for specialized use.

name: Aminoguanidine hydrochloride
description:
Aminoguanidine hydrochloride (CAS 1937-19-5 ), also known as Pimagedine hydrochloride, is a reactive guanidine derivative used primarily as a pharmaceutical intermediate and biochemical research reagent.

It functions as a carbonyl-trapping agent and selective inhibitor in synthetic and biological systems, making it a critical building block in drug development workflows for global manufacturers.

In pharmaceutical synthesis, it serves as a key intermediate in the preparation of heterocyclic compounds, including triazines, aminotriazoles, and guanidine-based active pharmaceutical ingredients.

Biotechnology researchers use it to study advanced glycation end-product formation, where its carbonyl-scavenging activity is central to mechanistic assays and compound screening programs.

It also functions as a catalyst or reactive intermediate in the synthesis of specialty agrochemical and fine chemical targets requiring guanidine scaffolds for specific industrial applications.

Contract manufacturers and API producers source it as a starting material for multi-step synthesis routes targeting cardiovascular and metabolic disease candidates in clinical development.

Aminoguanidine hydrochloride is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. It is available in research-grade and technical-grade specifications with high-purity grades commonly supplied.

Packaging ranges from small laboratory quantities to multi-kilogram industrial lots depending on application requirements, ensuring reliable supply for both R&D and large-scale production.

In polymer and plastics manufacturing, this compound acts as a catalyst precursor and processing stabilizer, supporting PVC thermal stabilization and polymerization control during production.

Its triglyceride profile delivers compatible melting behavior for high-end food production. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulators use it as a base for topical ointments and suppositories where its consistency supports controlled release.

name: Tetrapropylammonium bromide
description:
Tetrapropylammonium bromide (CAS 1941-30-6 ), commonly abbreviated as TPABr, is a quaternary ammonium salt used as a phase-transfer catalyst and structure-directing agent in chemical synthesis.

It enables efficient transfer of reagents between immiscible phases, accelerating reactions that would otherwise require harsh conditions or exotic solvents in industrial processes.

In pharmaceutical manufacturing, TPABr facilitates phase-transfer catalysis in the synthesis of active pharmaceutical ingredients, improving yields and reducing solvent consumption in multi-step organic reactions.

It functions as a structure-directing agent in the hydrothermal synthesis of zeolites, particularly ZSM-5 and related microporous materials used in catalytic cracking and adsorption processes.

In biotechnology and life sciences, it is used as a reagent in nucleic acid extraction protocols and as a counter-ion agent in ion-pair chromatography for precise analytical results.

TPABr also exhibits biocidal activity against a range of microorganisms, supporting its evaluation in preservation systems for industrial formulations and specialized chemical applications.

Tetrapropylammonium bromide is supplied as a white crystalline powder or granular solid. It is available in technical and high-purity grades for pharmaceutical and zeolite synthesis applications.

name: tert-butylhydroquinone
description:
Tert-butylhydroquinone (CAS 1948-33-0 ), commercially known as TBHQ, is a synthetic phenolic antioxidant used across food, industrial, and personal care markets. It prevents oxidative degradation in fats, oils, and polymers, extending shelf life and product stability.

Cosmetic and personal care formulators incorporate it into creams, lip products, and oil-based formulations to protect unsaturated ingredients from degradation during storage. This ensures that products maintain their intended texture and scent over time.

In plastics and polymer processing, it functions as a polymerization inhibitor and stabilizer, preventing premature crosslinking in resins and elastomers. This is critical for maintaining the structural integrity of industrial materials during manufacturing.

Lubricant and metalworking fluid producers use it to control oxidation in petroleum-based products, reducing deposit formation over service life. This application helps extend the operational efficiency of heavy machinery and automotive components.

TBHQ is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. Food-grade material is available meeting FCC and EU regulatory specifications, including purity requirements aligned with E 319 standards in applicable markets.

By reducing friction and improving combability, it is a staple in high-performance shampoos and conditioners. Skin care formulators incorporate it to enhance moisturizer spreadability and modify the sensory profile of lotions and gels.

This combination boosts meaty, broth-like flavor without increasing sodium load. Processed meat products such as sausages and meat-based sauces use it to reinforce natural flavor perception and reduce the need for added salt.

In savory crackers and flavored coatings, it contributes depth of taste that survives high-temperature processing. Pharmaceutical formulators also evaluate it as a nucleotide source in specialized nutritional preparations.

In food and nutraceutical formulations, SDA is incorporated into functional foods, dietary supplements, and fortified beverages targeting omega-3 enrichment without reliance on marine-sourced ingredients.

Feed manufacturers use it to enhance the omega-3 profile of livestock and aquaculture products, supporting the development of consumer-facing omega-3-enriched meat and dairy products.

It functions as an emollient, plasticizer, and lubricant carrier, valued for its low viscosity and skin-compatible profile in finished formulations. In cosmetics, it is used as an emollient and spreading agent.

It is frequently found in skin creams, sunscreens, and color cosmetics, where it improves texture and enhances active ingredient delivery. Lubricant formulators incorporate it as a base fluid or additive.

Textile and paper mills incorporate it into process baths to deactivate hardness ions that would otherwise interfere with dyeing uniformity or bleaching efficiency in the plant.

name: 1,4-Butanediol dimethacrylate
description:
1,4-Butanediol dimethacrylate (CAS 2082-81-7 ), commonly abbreviated as BDDMA, is a bifunctional methacrylate monomer used as a crosslinking agent across polymer and coating systems.

By linking polymer chains at two reactive sites, it controls network density, hardness, and solvent resistance in cured materials. In UV- and peroxide-cured coatings, it increases crosslink density.

This delivers harder, more chemically resistant films on wood, metal, and plastic substrates. Adhesive and sealant formulators incorporate it to tune cohesive strength and flexibility in structural systems.

In plastics and polymer manufacturing, it acts as a crosslinker in suspension polymerization to produce beads and resins with controlled swelling behavior. This is a critical parameter for ion-exchange media.

Personal care formulators use it to build film-forming polymer networks in nail gels and color cosmetics. Cure speed and film integrity are evaluated during qualification for these specific applications.

BDDMA is supplied as a clear liquid, typically with an inhibitor added to prevent premature polymerization during storage and transport. Standard commercial grades are available at purities of 97% and above.

Inhibitor type and concentration are specified on the product data sheet. Technical and specialty grades are offered to meet the requirements of coatings, adhesive, and personal care applications.

name: Cetyl laurate
description:
Cetyl laurate (CAS 20834-06-4 ), also known as palmityl laurate, is a fatty acid ester of cetyl alcohol and lauric acid used as an emollient, emulsifier, and texture modifier in cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations.

It contributes slip, skin feel, and structural consistency to finished products without the heaviness associated with heavier wax esters. In skincare and color cosmetics, it functions as an emollient and spreading agent.

It is frequently utilized in creams, lotions, and foundations, improving skin feel and product payoff. Lip care formulations use it to adjust texture and provide a smooth, non-greasy finish in balms and glosses.

Pharmaceutical topical preparations rely on it as a carrier and plasticizer in ointment bases and transdermal delivery systems where controlled spreadability matters. It also acts as a co-emulsifier in oil-in-water systems.

This material helps stabilize emulsions across a range of viscosities. Cetyl laurate is supplied as a white to off-white solid or flake at ambient temperature, transitioning to a clear liquid when melted.

It is available in cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications, with the latter typically meeting USP or Ph.Eur. standards for purity and identity. This ensures high quality for sensitive applications.

Bulk supply is standard in fiber drums or bags, with smaller packaging available for development and QA use. Our logistics network ensures timely delivery of high-purity esters for your manufacturing requirements.

name: Ethylenediamine-n,n'-disuccinic acid
description:
Ethylenediamine-N,N'-disuccinic acid (CAS 20846-91-7 ), commonly known as EDDS, is a biodegradable aminopolycarboxylate chelating agent used across industrial and consumer formulations.

It binds heavy metal ions — particularly iron, copper, and manganese — to prevent interference in product performance and process stability. In personal care formulations, EDDS sequesters trace metals.

This protects fragrance and active ingredients from metal-catalyzed degradation in rinse-off and leave-on products. Water treatment applications use it to control scale-forming metal ions effectively.

It also improves the efficiency of oxidative treatment processes. In agriculture, it functions as a metal chelate carrier — particularly for iron — enabling micronutrient delivery in fertilizer formulations.

This is vital where soil pH would otherwise render metals unavailable to plants. Textile and paper processing operations rely on EDDS to deactivate heavy metals that interfere with bleaching.

By improving consistency and reducing chemical waste, it enhances dyeing processes. EDDS is supplied primarily as an aqueous solution, with the trisodium and tetrasodium salt forms available.

Technical and industrial grades are standard across most supply channels. Buyers should confirm the stereoisomeric form, as the [S,S] enantiomer delivers the highest chelation efficiency.

This specific form is the specification most commonly referenced in formulation and agricultural applications. It ensures optimal performance across diverse industrial and chemical manufacturing sectors.

name: Creatine pyruvate
description:
Creatine pyruvate (CAS 208535-04-0 ) is a salt combining creatine and pyruvic acid, offering higher solubility and bioavailability than standard creatine monohydrate. It functions as a performance and energy metabolism ingredient in sports nutrition and health supplement formulations.

In sports nutrition, it is used in pre-workout and endurance supplements where improved creatine uptake and sustained energy release are formulation priorities. Pyruvate's role in cellular energy pathways makes this compound relevant for functional food and beverage products.

These products often target athletic recovery and metabolic support. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers incorporate it into capsule and tablet formats where enhanced bioavailability justifies the premium over conventional creatine salts.

Animal feed and veterinary nutrition represent a secondary channel, particularly in performance animal diets requiring efficient creatine delivery. The compound is highly valued for its dual-action metabolic benefits in various biological systems.

Creatine pyruvate is supplied as a white crystalline powder. It is available in food-grade and nutraceutical-grade specifications, with buyers typically evaluating purity levels of 98% and above for supplement applications.

Bulk quantities are standard for contract manufacturers, with smaller quantities available for R&D and formulation development. The material is processed to meet rigorous industry benchmarks including FCC and USP quality standards.

Our supply chain ensures consistent particle size and stability for seamless integration into dry mix or liquid formulations. This ensures that the final product maintains its efficacy and shelf life across diverse global markets.

name: Calcium benzoate
description:
Calcium benzoate (CAS 2090-05-3 ), also recognized by its food additive designation E213 , is the calcium salt of benzoic acid used as a preservative across food, pharmaceutical, and personal care applications.

It inhibits microbial growth, particularly yeasts, moulds, and bacteria, extending shelf life in acidic formulations where preservative activity is most effective for the final product stability.

In food and beverage manufacturing, E213 is approved for use in products such as margarines, low-sugar jams, and certain beverages as a cost-effective alternative to sodium benzoate where sodium reduction is a priority.

Pharmaceutical manufacturers incorporate it as a preservative in oral liquid formulations, syrups, and topical preparations requiring microbial stability over an extended shelf life for patient safety.

Personal care formulators use it in rinse-off and leave-on products, including shampoos and lotions, where broad-spectrum preservation at low pH is required for maintaining product integrity.

It also functions as a tablet coating agent and excipient in solid dosage form development. Calcium benzoate is supplied as a white crystalline powder or fine granules for various industrial uses.

Standard grades include food-grade material compliant with FCC and E213 purity specifications, as well as pharmaceutical-grade material meeting USP and BP requirements for global compliance.

Technical-grade material is also available for industrial preservation applications. These high-quality standards ensure the chemical meets the rigorous demands of modern manufacturing and safety protocols.

This compound is used as a reference standard, biochemical building block, and functional lipid ingredient across research and formulation contexts. In pharmaceutical and nutraceutical research, it serves as an analytical reference standard.

It is essential for fatty acid profiling and metabolic pathway studies. Personal care formulators incorporate it into lipid-rich skin preparations where omega-6 fatty acids are used to support barrier-relevant formulations.

In food and nutrition product development, it functions as a minor bioactive fatty acid component in specialty lipid blends targeting omega-6 nutritional profiles. It is also used in oxidative stability studies.
