It enables low-temperature vulcanization in products such as latex goods, sponge rubber, and extruded profiles. Cable insulation manufacturers use it where rapid, controlled crosslinking is required.

In polymer systems, it acts as a polymerization initiator and catalyst. This supports the production of specialty elastomers with defined molecular weight targets for industrial use.

Tire and industrial rubber goods producers select it when cure speed and scorch safety must be balanced. It is effective against demanding performance specifications in modern manufacturing.

name: Diethyltoluenediamine
description:
Diethyltoluenediamine ( CAS 2095-02-5 ), commonly known as DETDA, is an aromatic diamine used as a curing agent and chain extender in polyurethane and epoxy systems. It controls crosslink density and reaction kinetics in high-performance polymer formulations.

This chemical directly influences the mechanical and thermal performance of the cured material. In polyurethane elastomers, it functions as a chain extender in reaction injection molding (RIM) systems, where it determines hardness and flex fatigue resistance.

It is essential for managing demold times in automotive and industrial parts. Epoxy formulators use it as a curative in structural adhesives, composite matrices, and protective coatings where elevated heat resistance and chemical resistance are required.

In polyurea spray coatings, it is incorporated into the amine component to tune reactivity and extend pot life. This is particularly useful for construction waterproofing and the development of corrosion-resistant linings for industrial use.

Sealant and cast elastomer manufacturers also use it to achieve specific Shore hardness profiles in demanding sealing and gasketing applications. The material is supplied as an amber to light yellow liquid for various industrial processes.

Technical grade is the standard commercial form, with purity typically specified at 98% or higher. Drum and IBC packaging are the common supply formats for industrial buyers seeking reliable chemical sourcing for large-scale production.

name: Tallow bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amine oxide
description:
Tallow bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amine oxide (CAS 2097729-23-0 ) is a tertiary amine oxide surfactant derived from tallow fatty chains, combining C16–C18 saturated and unsaturated alkyl groups with a bis-hydroxyethyl oxide head.

It functions as a foam booster, viscosity modifier, and conditioning agent across detergent and personal care formulations. In liquid dish soaps and hard-surface cleaners, it boosts foam density and stabilizes lather.

The product enhances grease removal at low use levels. Personal care formulators incorporate it into shampoos and body washes to improve foam quality and deposit conditioning benefits on hair and skin.

Textile processing operations use it as a wetting and softening agent to improve fiber penetration during dyeing and finishing. Industrial cleaning concentrates benefit from its compatibility with anionic and nonionic systems.

It contributes viscosity building without requiring additional thickeners. Tallow bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amine oxide is typically supplied as an aqueous solution, with active content commonly in the 25–35% range.

Technical and industrial grades are the standard commercial offering for this product. Packaging options generally include drums and intermediate bulk containers suited to industrial procurement volumes.

name: Quaternium-45
description:
Quaternium-45 (CAS 21034-17-3 ) is a quaternary ammonium compound used in personal care formulations for surface modification and stabilization. It functions as a conditioning and wetting agent, helping to improve the feel and performance consistency of cosmetic products.

In hair care formulations, this compound is used to modify surface charge on hair fibers, improving combability and reducing static. Skin care and leave-on products incorporate it to enhance ingredient adhesion and uniform distribution across the skin surface.

It also serves a stabilizing role in emulsion-based formulations, helping to maintain system integrity over shelf life. Conditioning rinses and treatment masks may include it at low concentrations to deliver targeted surface-active effects during application.

Quaternium-45 is typically supplied as a solid or powder. It is available in cosmetic-grade specification, with purity levels suited to personal care manufacturing requirements. Buyers should confirm grade documentation and batch consistency with suppliers.

name: Cobalt dihydroxide
description:
Cobalt dihydroxide (CAS 21041-93-0 ), also sold as cobaltous hydroxide, is an inorganic cobalt compound used as a precursor and catalyst intermediate across battery materials, pigment, and specialty chemical manufacturing.

Its primary commercial role is converting into higher-value cobalt compounds through controlled thermal or chemical processing. In lithium-ion battery supply chains, it serves as a direct precursor to cobalt oxide and lithium cobalt oxide cathode materials.

This makes it a critical upstream input for battery-grade chemical producers. Ceramic and glass manufacturers use it to introduce cobalt-based blue pigments into frits and glazes where consistent cobalt loading is required.

In catalysis, it functions as a starting material for producing supported cobalt catalysts used in hydroprocessing and Fischer-Tropsch synthesis. Specialty chemical producers also use it as a reactive intermediate.

It is frequently utilized when synthesizing cobalt salts such as cobalt naphthenate or cobalt acetate. Cobalt dihydroxide is supplied as a fine powder, typically in varying particle size distributions suited to downstream processing.

Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with high-purity grades available for battery and catalyst applications where trace metal limits are tightly controlled. Packaging ranges from small drums to bulk quantities.

name: Barium sulfide
description:
Barium sulfide (CAS 21109-95-5 ), also known as barium sulphide and BaS, is an inorganic salt used industrially as a reducing and bleaching agent. It functions primarily as a precursor chemical and depilatory agent across several process-intensive industries.

In leather processing, barium sulfide is applied as a hair-removal agent during the beamhouse stage, offering an alternative to sodium sulfide for dehairing hides. This application is critical for preparing raw materials for tanning.

The mining and metals sector uses it in the production of other barium compounds and as a precipitant for removing sulfate ions from process streams. This ensures efficient chemical recovery and waste management in heavy industrial operations.

Pulp and paper operations have historically employed it in bleaching and chemical recovery processes where strong reducing conditions are required. Its chemical properties allow for effective treatment of wood fibers during production.

In textile processing, it supports desizing and preparation stages where sulfide-based chemistry is specified. This helps in achieving the desired texture and cleanliness of fabrics before they undergo further dyeing or finishing.

Barium sulfide is supplied as a grey to off-white powder or granular solid. Technical grade is the standard commercial form, with purity levels typically specified by active BaS content to meet industrial requirements.

Myristyl glycol (CAS 21129-09-9 ), also known as tetradecylene glycol or 1,2-tetradecanediol, is a long-chain fatty diol used primarily in personal care and pharmaceutical formulations.

It functions as a skin-conditioning agent, emollient carrier, and emulsification aid across a range of topical product types. In premium skincare and cosmetic formulations, it acts as a moisturizing agent.

It serves as a texture enhancer in creams, lotions, and serums, contributing to skin feel without heavy residue. Its carrier properties make it suitable for solubilizing active ingredients in various products.

This chemical offers a milder neutralizing base compared to conventional sodium or ammonium counterparts. In shampoos, body washes, and liquid hand soaps, it delivers effective sebum and soil removal alongside stable, dense foam.

Formulators working on conditioning cleansers favor it where the isopropanolamine counter-ion contributes to improved compatibility with conditioning actives. It is highly effective in household and industrial cleaning products.

description:
Menaquinone 7 (CAS 2124-57-4 ), commonly known as MK-7, is a long-chain form of Vitamin K2 used as a bioactive nutrient ingredient across food, supplement, and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Its extended half-life in the body makes it the preferred K2 form for finished product formulators targeting bone and cardiovascular health positioning in various global markets.

In dietary supplement manufacturing, MK-7 is incorporated into softgels, tablets, and capsules. It is often combined with Vitamin D3 for bone density and cardiovascular support formulations.

Food and beverage producers use it to fortify functional foods such as dairy products, meal replacements, and fortified drinks where K2 labeling is a commercial differentiator for brands.

Pharmaceutical-grade MK-7 is used in nutraceutical drug-adjacent products where documented bioavailability and purity documentation are essential procurement requirements for quality assurance.

In animal nutrition, it is added to poultry and livestock feed premixes to support bone development and egg quality, ensuring high standards for agricultural production and livestock health.

MK-7 is supplied as a fine powder, oil suspension, or microencapsulated form to suit different manufacturing processes. Standard grades include food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade options.

Specifications are aligned to USP and Ph.Eur. monographs where applicable. Concentrations typically range from 0.1% to 1% in carrier-based or encapsulated formats for blending.

name: Padimate-O
description:
Padimate-O (CAS 21245-02-3 ), also known commercially as Ethylhexyl Dimethyl PABA, is an oil-soluble UV absorber that filters UVB radiation in the 290–315 nm range.

It is used across personal care, polymer, and printing applications to protect formulations and substrates from UV-induced degradation. In sunscreen and cosmetic formulations, it functions as an approved UVB filter.

The material is incorporated into lotions, creams, and lip care products to meet SPF performance targets. Polymer manufacturers use it as a UV stabilizer in plastic films and coatings where resistance is required.

In printing and packaging, it is incorporated into UV-curable ink and coating systems. It contributes to controlled photoinitiator activity and cross-linking behavior in these specific industrial applications.

Its reactivity with certain resin systems positions it as a building block or catalyst precursor in specialty curing formulations. This versatility makes it a staple in high-performance chemical manufacturing.

Padimate-O is supplied as a pale yellow to amber liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade specifications meeting requirements for inclusion in regulated personal care products across major global markets.

Technical-grade material is also available for industrial polymer and printing applications. Our supply chain ensures consistent quality and availability for large-scale manufacturing and formulation needs.

name: 2-(acetoacetoxy)ethyl methacrylate
description:
2-(Acetoacetoxy)ethyl methacrylate (CAS 21282-97-3 ), commercially known as AAEM and supplied under trade names such as Eastman AAEM and LONZAMON AAEMA, is a functional monomer that introduces reactive acetoacetate groups into polymer backbones.

These pendant groups enable post-polymerization crosslinking, metal chelation, and adhesion promotion across a broad range of coating and adhesive systems. In waterborne coatings, AAEM is incorporated into acrylic latex polymers.

This enables ambient-temperature crosslinking with polyamines or dihydrazides, improving hardness, chemical resistance, and block resistance in architectural and industrial finishes. Adhesive formulators use it to enhance substrate adhesion.

It also improves cohesive strength in pressure-sensitive and structural adhesive systems. In UV-curable formulations, the acetoacetate functionality participates in Michael addition reactions, allowing dual-cure systems that reduce shrinkage.

These systems improve film flexibility while printing inks and packaging coatings benefit from its ability to improve ink adhesion to difficult substrates, including plastics and treated films. AAEM is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid.

It is available in technical and industrial grades, with inhibited versions standard for storage stability during transport and handling. Bulk, drum, and intermediate bulk container packaging options are typical for industrial supply.

name: Lithium hexafluorophosphate
description:
Lithium hexafluorophosphate (CAS 21324-40-3 ), commonly referenced as LiPF6, is the dominant electrolyte salt in commercial lithium-ion battery manufacturing. It enables efficient lithium-ion transport between electrodes, directly determining cell conductivity and cycle life.

LiPF6 is the primary electrolyte solute in lithium-ion cells used across electric vehicles, consumer electronics, and grid-scale energy storage. It is dissolved in carbonate solvent blends to form the electrolyte solution for various applications.

Battery manufacturers formulate electrolytes at specific concentrations to meet cell performance targets for capacity retention and rate capability. Beyond standard Li-ion cells, it is used in electrolyte development for solid-state research.

Next-generation lithium battery research relies on this material for testing and development. Electrolyte producers and cell manufacturers source it as a critical input for both production-scale electrolyte blending and R&D formulation work.

Lithium hexafluorophosphate is supplied as a white crystalline powder or in pre-dissolved electrolyte solution form. Battery-grade is the commercially relevant specification, with purity levels typically at 99.9% or higher.

Strict controls are maintained on moisture, HF content, and metallic impurities to ensure performance. Packaging is offered in moisture-controlled formats, sealed under inert atmosphere, given the material's sensitivity to humidity.

Proper handling during storage and transit is essential to maintain the chemical integrity of the salt. This ensures that the final battery cells meet the rigorous safety and efficiency standards required by the global energy industry.

name: DL-Camphor
description:
DL-Camphor (CAS 21368-68-3 ) is the racemic synthetic form of camphor, produced via chemical synthesis rather than natural extraction. Known commercially simply as Camphor, it is the standard industrial grade used across personal care and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

It functions primarily as a topical active, fragrance component, and processing solvent in finished formulations. In pharmaceuticals, it is incorporated into topical analgesic and counterirritant preparations such as medicated balms and liniments.

Personal care manufacturers use it as a cooling and masking agent in products including lip balms, skin creams, and hair tonics. As a fragrance ingredient, it contributes a sharp, medicinal note to perfumery bases and functional cosmetic formulations.

It also acts as a plasticizer solvent in cellulose nitrate lacquers and specialty coatings, particularly in nail care product manufacturing. This versatile chemical is supplied as white crystalline powder, granules, or pressed blocks depending on requirements.

Standard commercial grades include USP , BP , and technical grade, with these specifications most commonly required for pharmaceutical and personal care applications. Purity levels of 96% and above are typical for industrial supply.

The material is handled according to strict safety protocols due to its volatile nature and characteristic odor. Suppliers ensure that the synthetic racemic mixture meets the rigorous demands of global regulatory bodies for topical use.

description:

It functions as an antioxidant, antimicrobial agent, and UV stabilizer in formulated products. In pharmaceutical development, 2,3,4-THB serves as a bioactive intermediate and antioxidant stabilizer.

It is utilized in active ingredient synthesis and finished dosage formulations. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into skincare products for its UV-protective and preservation properties.

This is particularly useful in formulations targeting oxidative stress or requiring extended shelf stability. Its aldehyde and phenolic character make it relevant in flavor and fragrance compounding.

It contributes to aromatic profiles in specialty applications. Research and fine chemical manufacturers also source it as a building block for synthesizing heterocyclic compounds and novel bioactive molecules.

2,3,4-Trihydroxybenzaldehyde is supplied as a solid crystalline powder. It is available primarily in research and technical grades, with high-purity specifications typically exceeding 98%.

These grades are suited to pharmaceutical intermediates and specialty formulation work. Packaging ranges from small laboratory quantities to bulk orders depending on specific supplier capability.

name: 2-(thiocyanomethylthio)benzothiazole
description:
2-(Thiocyanomethylthio)benzothiazole (CAS 21564-17-0 ), commercially known as TCMTB, is a broad-spectrum biocide used across industrial manufacturing and water treatment applications. Marketed under trade names such as Alentisan and Ichiban, it controls fungal and bacterial growth.

This chemical is essential in process environments where microbial contamination leads to product degradation or equipment fouling. In leather and textile processing, it is applied as a preservative in wet-end operations.

It prevents microbial spoilage of hides, pelts, and fiber materials during storage and transport. Pulp and paper mills use it as a slimicide to inhibit biofilm formation in process water systems, reducing downtime.

This application prevents contamination of finished paper stock and maintains system efficiency. Coating, adhesive, and sealant formulators incorporate it as an in-can preservative to extend shelf life.

It is highly effective at preventing spoilage of water-based formulations during long-term storage. Industrial water treatment programs rely on this compound to control microbial populations in cooling towers.

It is also utilized in recirculating systems to ensure operational stability. The product is supplied primarily as a liquid concentrate, typically in aqueous or solvent-based formulations at active concentrations of around 30%.

Technical grade is the standard commercial specification for industrial applications. It is available in bulk quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes and large-scale manufacturing requirements.

name: Hexafluoroisopropyl acrylate
description:
Hexafluoroisopropyl acrylate (CAS 2160-89-6 ) is a fluorinated acrylic monomer used to introduce extreme hydrophobicity, chemical resistance, and low surface energy into polymer systems.

It functions as a reactive building block in specialty coatings, optical materials, and high-performance polymer formulations where standard acrylates cannot meet durability requirements.

In electronics and photonics, it is incorporated into UV-curable resins and optical coatings where low refractive index and moisture resistance are critical performance targets.

Aerospace and defense coating formulators use it to produce films with exceptional resistance to fuels, solvents, and aggressive atmospheric conditions during operation.

In fluoropolymer synthesis, it serves as a comonomer to tune the surface energy and chemical resistance profile of specialty membranes and release coatings for industrial use.

Researchers and industrial formulators also apply it in anti-fouling and hydrophobic surface treatments for substrates requiring durable, low-adhesion finishes and protection.

Hexafluoroisopropyl acrylate is supplied as a liquid monomer, typically with an inhibitor added to prevent premature polymerization during storage and transport phases.

It is available in technical and research-grade specifications, with purity levels commonly ranging from 97% upward for industrial and advanced material applications globally.

In adhesives, sealants, and elastomer systems, it acts as a reactive component or cure modifier where controlled basicity is required. This versatility makes it essential for high-performance industrial applications.

name: Bis(2,6-diisopropylphenyl)carbodiimide
description:
Bis(2,6-diisopropylphenyl)carbodiimide (CAS 2162-74-5 ), commercially known as Staboxol 1, is a monomeric carbodiimide stabilizer used to protect polymers and lubricant formulations from hydrolytic degradation.

It reacts with carboxylic acid groups generated during polymer breakdown, interrupting chain scission before it causes measurable property loss. In polyester, polyurethane, and polylactic acid compounds, it extends service life.

By neutralizing acidic degradation products that would otherwise accelerate molecular weight loss, it ensures material integrity. Lubricant and metalworking fluid formulators incorporate it to maintain viscosity stability.

It protects ester-based base oils under high-temperature or moisture-exposed operating conditions. Automotive under-hood components, including seals, gaskets, and engineering plastic parts, benefit from its inclusion.

Where thermal and hydrolytic stress would otherwise shorten part lifespan, this stabilizer provides essential protection. It is also used in film and fiber processing where maintaining melt viscosity consistency is a requirement.

Ensuring quality across production runs is a direct result of its chemical properties. Bis(2,6-diisopropylphenyl)carbodiimide is supplied as a white to off-white powder or solid for industrial use.

Technical and polymer-stabilizer grades are the standard commercial forms available from specialty chemical suppliers. Packaging typically ranges from kilogram-scale laboratory quantities to multi-kilogram industrial lots.

name: Methylpropanediol
description:
Methylpropanediol (CAS 2163-42-0 ), commonly abbreviated as MPD, is a diol solvent and humectant used across personal care, pharmaceutical, and polymer manufacturing. Its low viscosity and strong solvency make it a practical alternative to propylene glycol.

In personal care, MPD functions as a humectant and solvent in skin creams, serums, and hair care products. It improves active ingredient delivery and texture without the heaviness of conventional glycols often found in these formulations.

Pharmaceutical formulators use it as a carrier solvent in topical preparations where controlled penetration and stability are required. It provides a reliable medium for active pharmaceutical ingredients in various medical applications.

In polymer chemistry, MPD serves as a monomer or chain extender in the production of polyesters, polyurethanes, and UV-curable resins. It contributes significantly to the flexibility and crosslink density in the final material.

Coatings and adhesive manufacturers also incorporate it as a reactive intermediate to tune film performance. This versatility makes it a staple in industrial chemical synthesis and high-performance material engineering.

Methylpropanediol is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid in standard drum and IBC quantities. Cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications are the most commonly available for industrial and commercial procurement.

Cosmetic-grade material meets purity requirements suitable for leave-on and rinse-off personal care applications. Pharmaceutical-grade supply is available from select manufacturers for use in regulated topical formulations.

name: Aluminum hydroxide
description:
Aluminum hydroxide (CAS 21645-51-2 ), also sold as hydrated alumina, is an inorganic mineral compound used across industrial and pharmaceutical markets as a flame retardant, antacid active, and catalyst precursor.

Its function shifts significantly by grade and particle size, making specification alignment critical at the sourcing stage. In plastics and polymer compounding, it acts as a halogen-free flame retardant and smoke suppressant.

The material is incorporated into cable jacketing, flooring, and construction panels to meet fire safety standards. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as an active ingredient in antacid formulations where it neutralizes excess gastric acid.

Sold historically under the brand Amphojel, it is used in OTC tablet and suspension products. In the paper and textile industries, it functions as a mordant and surface treatment agent, improving dye fixation and coating adhesion.

Catalyst producers also use it as a precursor for alumina-based catalysts applied in refining and chemical synthesis. The product is supplied as a fine white powder, with particle size and surface area varying by intended application.

Standard grades include USP and BP for pharmaceutical use, and technical or flame-retardant grades for industrial polymer applications. FCC -grade material is available for food-contact and food-additive applications.

Controlled tin activity influences molecular weight and reaction rate during synthesis. It is used in the synthesis of organotin compounds, which serve as downstream catalysts and stabilizers in PVC and other polymer formulations.

Manufacturers of tin-based catalyst systems source this material as a starting material for producing dibutyltin and other organometallic derivatives. Its role in polymerization initiation is critical for specialty resin producers.

The material is supplied as a dark powder, typically in technical grade suitable for industrial catalyst and chemical synthesis applications. Purity specifications commonly range from 97% to 99%+ for industrial use.

name: Itaconic anhydride
description:
Itaconic anhydride (CAS 2170-03-8 ), also known as Methylenesuccinic anhydride, is a reactive cyclic anhydride derived from itaconic acid. It functions as a monomer and chemical building block.

This material introduces reactive double bonds and anhydride groups into polymer systems to enable controlled functionalization and cross-linking. In plastics and polymer manufacturing, it is incorporated into resin formulations.

These formulations modify backbone reactivity, enabling tailored adhesion, hydrophilicity, or cross-link density in specialty coatings and films. Formulators in home care use it to produce comb polymers and dispersants.

These polycarboxylate dispersants improve soil suspension and anti-redeposition performance in detergent systems. In printing and packaging, it serves as a co-monomer in binder resins and adhesive formulations.

Controlled cure response and substrate adhesion are critical in these applications. Its anhydride group also enables post-polymerization grafting reactions, making it a candidate for surface-reactive polymer intermediates.

Itaconic anhydride is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline solid. It is available in technical grade, with packaging options typically ranging from small laboratory quantities to multi-kilogram industrial lots.

Purity specifications commonly cited in the market are ≥97% and ≥98% by GC. Storage requirements reflect its moisture sensitivity, requiring careful handling to maintain the integrity of the chemical profile.

name: Trolamine salicylate
description:
Trolamine salicylate (CAS 2174-16-5 ), also known as triethanolamine salicylate, TEA-Salicylate, and marketed under the trade name Neo Heliopan TS, is the salt formed between triethanolamine and salicylic acid.

It functions as both a UV-absorbing active and a topical analgesic agent across personal care and pharmaceutical applications. In sunscreen formulations, it absorbs UVB radiation in the 290–320 nm range.

This provides photoprotection in lotions, creams, and sprays without requiring insoluble mineral filters. Topical OTC analgesic products including muscle rubs, joint creams, and pain-relief gels rely on it as the active ingredient.

Its water solubility allows formulators to build clear, aqueous-phase sunscreen and cosmetic products where oil-soluble UV filters would compromise aesthetics. This makes it a versatile choice for localized pain management.

Pharmaceutical manufacturers also use it as an intermediate in developing salicylate-based dermatological preparations. It is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder or as an aqueous solution.

The material is available in cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications, with the latter conforming to USP standards. This ensures high purity for sensitive medical and skincare applications.

Packaging typically ranges from kilogram quantities for formulators to bulk drum supply for industrial manufacturers. This flexibility supports both small-scale research and large-scale commercial production needs.

Its subtle camphoraceous character supports specific flavor profiles in various edible products. In personal care formulations, including shampoos, body washes, and skin creams, it functions as a fragrance component, providing lasting scent performance.

Household and industrial cleaning products also incorporate it to deliver controlled, pleasant odor profiles at use concentrations. The compound is valued for its stability and versatility across a wide range of pH levels and product bases.

This product protects downhole equipment and ensures efficient flow. Textile and leather processors apply it to sequester hardness ions in process baths, improving dye uptake consistency and preventing metal-induced fabric damage.

In pulp and paper production, it stabilizes peroxide bleaching baths by deactivating trace metal ions that would otherwise decompose the bleach prematurely. This ensures maximum efficiency during the bleaching process.

name: Acetylpyrazine
description:
Acetylpyrazine (CAS 22047-25-2 ), also identified by FEMA 3126 , is a synthetic flavoring compound used in food and fragrance applications. It delivers a characteristic roasted, nutty, popcorn-like aroma that is difficult to replicate with natural alternatives.

Formulators rely on it to build or enhance cooked, toasted, and grain-like flavor profiles at low use levels. In food flavoring, it is used to create or reinforce roasted notes in snack seasonings, bakery products, and savory blends.

Popcorn and corn-based snack flavors depend heavily on this compound to achieve authentic character. In beverage applications, it contributes roasted depth to coffee, cocoa, and malt-flavored drink formulations for a more robust profile.

Fragrance and personal care formulators incorporate it into compositions targeting smoky, gourmand, or tobacco-adjacent scent profiles. It is highly effective at low concentrations, making it a cost-efficient choice for complex aromatic builds.

Its low volatility and good solvating power make it a practical choice for formulators balancing performance with processability. In plastics processing, it functions as a plasticizer and secondary lubricant in PVC and other polymer systems.

The compound improves flexibility and reduces internal friction during extrusion or calendering. Personal care formulators incorporate it into skin creams, sunscreens, and color cosmetics as a lightweight emollient carrier.

It spreads active ingredients without a greasy residue, making it ideal for topical applications. Metalworking and industrial lubricant manufacturers use it as a base fluid or additive in cutting oils and release agents.

description:
Laureth-6 carboxylic acid (CAS 220622-96-8 ) is an ether carboxylate surfactant derived from ethoxylated lauryl/myristyl alcohol with a carboxymethyl head group. It combines mild surfactancy with pH-dependent ionization, making it effective across both acidic and alkaline formulation environments.

In textile processing, it functions as a scouring and emulsifying agent, helping remove oils and sizing agents from fiber without damaging delicate materials. Leather and paper processing operations use it to control interfacial tension.

name: Glucosylglycerol
description:
Glucosylglycerol (CAS 22160-26-5 ) is a naturally occurring glycoside composed of glucose and glycerol, produced biotechnologically for commercial supply. Found in cyanobacteria and certain plants as an osmotic stress protectant, it functions industrially as a humectant.

This skin-conditioning agent offers strong moisture-retention performance. In cosmetic formulations, it is used in serums, moisturizers, and leave-on treatments where it draws and retains water in the skin's upper layers.

It supports hydration without the tackiness associated with glycerol at high concentrations. Its compatibility with sensitive-skin formulations makes it a preferred humectant in baby care and dermatological product lines.

In food and nutraceutical applications, it is evaluated as a functional ingredient in hydration-focused beverages and dietary supplements. Pharmaceutical formulators also assess it as a stabilizing excipient for moisture-sensitive active ingredients.

It is utilized in both topical and oral preparations. Glucosylglycerol is supplied as an aqueous solution, typically at concentrations around 50% or higher, suited for direct incorporation into liquid formulations.

Cosmetic-grade and food-grade designations are the most commercially relevant specifications available from established producers. Purity and grade documentation varies by supplier, so buyers should confirm specification sheets.

Ensure that all documentation aligns with your specific regulatory and application requirements. This ensures the material meets the necessary safety and performance standards for your final product manufacturing.

Contact us for supply of Glucosylglycerol

name: Tri-sec-butyl borate
description:
Tri-sec-butyl borate (CAS 22238-17-1 ) is an organoboron ester used industrially as a catalyst and cross-linking agent. It delivers controlled reactivity in polymer curing and surface treatment processes where precise boron delivery is required.

In plastics and polymer manufacturing, it functions as a cross-linking agent for resins and coatings, improving film integrity and adhesion performance. Lubricant formulators incorporate it as an additive precursor.

Boron-containing compounds contribute to load-bearing and anti-wear performance in metalworking fluids. In industrial cleaning formulations, it supports surface-active systems that require controlled hydrolysis behavior.

This allows for the release of active boron species during application. It also serves as a catalyst in esterification and condensation reactions, relevant to specialty chemical synthesis feeding into polymer supply chains.

Tri-sec-butyl borate is supplied as a liquid, typically handled in sealed containers under inert conditions. This is necessary due to moisture sensitivity during storage and transit to ensure product stability.

Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity specifications commonly at 95% or higher. Packaging ranges from small laboratory quantities to drum-scale volumes for industrial procurement.

name: Vinyltris(methylethylketoxime)silane
description:
Vinyltris(methylethylketoxime)silane (CAS 2224-33-1 ), also referenced in technical literature as Vinyltris(methylethylketoximino)silane, is an oxime-functional silane crosslinker used in the formulation of room-temperature-vulcanizing (RTV) silicone systems.

It releases methylethylketoxime upon moisture exposure, enabling controlled cure in one-component silicone sealants and coatings. Its primary use is as a crosslinker in neutral-cure RTV-1 silicone sealants.

The material provides good adhesion to glass, metals, and plastics without the acidity associated with acetoxy systems. This is a key advantage in construction and automotive glazing applications where substrate protection is vital.

In electronics, it is used in conformal coatings and potting compounds where corrosion-sensitive substrates require a non-corrosive cure chemistry. Silicone elastomer formulators use it to tune mechanical properties.

It helps adjust cure speed in industrial gaskets and sealing profiles. It also functions as a surface modifier in silicone-based adhesives, improving substrate compatibility and bond durability in demanding assembly processes.

The product is supplied as a clear to slightly yellow liquid in standard packaging ranging from drums to IBC containers. Technical-grade is the primary commercial form, with purity specifications typically at 98% or above.

Bulk supply is available for industrial formulators with consistent volume requirements. This chemical ensures high performance and stability in various industrial silicone applications across multiple global manufacturing sectors.

Contact us for supply of Vinyltris(methylethylketoxime)silane

name: Triethanolamine laurate
description:
Triethanolamine laurate (CAS 2224-49-9 ), also known as TEA-Laurate, is the triethanolamine salt of lauric acid. It is a mild anionic surfactant used across personal care, cleaning, and industrial formulations.

It functions primarily as an emulsifier, wetting agent, and detergent base, enabling stable oil-in-water systems. This versatile chemical provides effective soil removal across a broad range of pH conditions.

In personal care, it anchors emulsified creams, lotions, and cleansing products where a mild, skin-compatible surfactant is required. Textile and leather processors use it as a wetting and scouring agent.

This improves fiber penetration and surface uniformity during wet processing. Industrial and household cleaning formulations incorporate it for its degreasing performance and compatibility with other surfactant blends.

In coatings and adhesive systems, it supports pigment dispersion and substrate wetting. This improves coating uniformity and adhesion across various industrial applications and manufacturing processes.

Triethanolamine laurate is typically supplied as a liquid or paste, depending on concentration and formulation. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades for diverse commercial requirements.

Cosmetic-grade material meets purity standards relevant to personal care manufacturing. Packaging commonly ranges from drums to intermediate bulk containers for industrial supply volumes.

name: Hydrolyzed pea protein
description:
Hydrolyzed pea protein (CAS 222400-29-5 ) is produced by enzymatic or acid hydrolysis of pea-derived protein into peptides and free amino acids. It functions as a functional protein ingredient across food, personal care, and animal nutrition markets.

This versatile ingredient delivers emulsification, foaming, and moisture-retention performance. In food manufacturing, it acts as a plant-based foaming and emulsifying agent in whipped toppings, meat analogues, and protein-fortified beverages.

It is frequently utilized where clean-label positioning is a priority for the manufacturer. Personal care formulators incorporate it into hair conditioners, shampoos, and skin creams to support moisture retention and film formation.

The ingredient provides structural support on hair and skin surfaces for cosmetic applications. In animal feed applications, the hydrolyzed format improves protein digestibility and palatability for various species.

It is particularly effective in early-life nutrition for livestock and aquaculture. It also serves as a functional binder and texturizer in plant-based processed food systems targeting vegan and allergen-sensitive consumer segments.

The product is supplied primarily as a spray-dried powder, though liquid concentrate forms are available. Food-grade is the standard specification, with some grades meeting kosher and halal certification requirements.

Protein content and degree of hydrolysis vary by grade, making supplier specification sheets critical. These documents ensure proper formulation matching for specific industrial and commercial applications across global markets.

name: 4-Hydroxy-TEMPO
description:
4-Hydroxy-TEMPO (CAS 2226-96-2 ), commercially known as TEMPOL, is a stable nitroxide radical used across polymer, pharmaceutical, and personal care manufacturing. It functions primarily as a polymerization inhibitor and radical scavenger.

This chemical acts as a process stabilizer, preventing premature crosslinking or degradation during production and storage. In polymer and resin manufacturing, it inhibits unwanted radical polymerization in monomer streams.

By protecting product integrity during transport and storage, it ensures high-quality outcomes. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a controlled radical mediator in active ingredient synthesis and as an antioxidant stabilizer.

In personal care, it is incorporated into formulations requiring oxidative stability. This is particularly important where free radical chain reactions would compromise shelf life or efficacy in the final consumer product.

TEMPOL also serves as a catalyst in selective oxidation reactions, including the conversion of primary alcohols to aldehydes. This functionality is essential in fine chemical and API synthesis workflows for modern medicine.

The product is supplied as a crystalline solid, typically as an orange to red-orange powder or granules. It is available in technical and high-purity grades, with purity specifications commonly ranging from 97% to 99%+.

These grades are suitable for research, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications. Packaging options range from small laboratory quantities to bulk industrial supply, depending on specific application requirements and scale.

Contact us for supply of 4-Hydroxy-TEMPO

name: Tri-C14-15 Alkyl Citrate
description:
Tri-C14-15 Alkyl Citrate (CAS 222721-94-0 ) is a citric acid triester derived from C14–C15 fatty alcohols, functioning as an emollient, plasticizer, and emulsifier across personal care and industrial formulations.

Its ester structure positions it as a bio-based alternative to synthetic plasticizers in applications where regulatory or sustainability criteria influence sourcing decisions for modern manufacturing.

In personal care, it acts as a skin-conditioning emollient and emulsifier in creams, lotions, and color cosmetics, contributing to texture and spreadability without a heavy feel for the end user.

Formulators in coatings and adhesives use it as a plasticizer to improve flexibility and film formation in polymer systems. In home care and industrial cleaning products, it supports emulsification.

This chemical supports the emulsification of oils and actives within surfactant-based systems. Food-contact and packaging applications may also draw on its citrate ester chemistry where compliant options are required.

Tri-C14-15 Alkyl Citrate is typically supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the distinct purity requirements of various uses.

The product is manufactured to meet high quality standards for personal care versus industrial end uses. Bulk supply is standard in drums and intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) for global distribution.

name: Barium hydroxide monohydrate
description:
Barium hydroxide monohydrate (CAS 22326-55-2 ) is a strong inorganic base supplied in solid form, distinct from the anhydrous and octahydrate variants in handling characteristics and water content.

It functions primarily as a pH regulator, alkaline catalyst, and precipitating agent across chemical manufacturing and industrial processing. In water treatment, it precipitates sulfate and heavy metal ions.

This enables effluent compliance in industrial discharge streams. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a base catalyst in synthesis steps where controlled alkalinity and low ionic contamination are critical.

Mining and metallurgical operations apply it to adjust leach circuit pH and to remove sulfate from process water. This reduces scaling and corrosion in downstream equipment during processing.

In biotechnology and laboratory settings, it supports CO₂ absorption and reagent preparation where a reliable, consistent alkaline source is required for sensitive chemical reactions.

The product is supplied as a white powder or granule. Technical grade is the standard commercial form, with reagent and pharmaceutical grades available for higher-purity applications.

Packaging typically ranges from multi-wall bags to bulk quantities depending on application scale. All batches are manufactured to meet rigorous industrial and chemical safety specifications.

name: Dodecylbis(2-hydroxyethyl)methylammonium chloride
description:
Dodecylbis(2-hydroxyethyl)methylammonium chloride (CAS 22340-01-8 ) is a quaternary ammonium compound functioning as a cationic surfactant with broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity. It delivers simultaneous biocidal, emulsifying, and surface-active performance across industrial and personal care applications.

In water treatment, it controls microbial growth in cooling towers, industrial process water, and wastewater systems where biofilm formation is a persistent operational problem. Personal care formulators incorporate it into conditioning rinses and skin cleansers.

It is also used in preservative systems where cationic substantivity to hair and skin surfaces is commercially valuable. Textile and leather processors use it as an antistatic and softening agent during finishing operations, improving handle and reducing static charge.

In industrial cleaning and printing applications, it supports degreasing formulations and ink-system maintenance where both surface wetting and microbial control are required simultaneously. This versatility makes it a staple in chemical manufacturing.

Dodecylbis(2-hydroxyethyl)methylammonium chloride is typically supplied as an aqueous solution, with active content concentrations commonly ranging from 50% to 80%. Technical grade is the standard offering for industrial water treatment and textile markets.

Personal care applications may require higher-purity specifications with documented impurity profiles to meet formulation compliance requirements. The material is handled according to standard safety protocols for quaternary ammonium compounds.

name: Pentasodium aminotrimethylene phosphonate
description:
Pentasodium aminotrimethylene phosphonate (CAS 2235-43-0 ) is the pentasodium salt form of ATMP, a phosphonate chelating agent used to control scale formation and metal ion interference.

Its ability to sequester calcium, magnesium, and heavy metal ions makes it a standard input in water treatment chemistry and process fluid formulation for various industrial systems.

In cooling water and boiler systems, it inhibits calcium carbonate and calcium sulfate scale deposition, protecting heat exchange surfaces and extending equipment service life effectively.

Textile and paper processing operations use it to sequester hardness ions in process water, preventing interference with dyes, bleaches, and sizing agents during the manufacturing cycle.

In oilfield applications, it functions as a scale inhibitor in injection water and produced water treatment, where mineral scaling in pipelines and wellbores is a persistent problem.

Mining and metals processing operations apply it in leaching circuits and metal surface treatment baths to stabilize metal ion concentrations and reduce corrosion on process equipment.

The product is supplied as a clear to pale yellow aqueous solution, typically at 40–50% active content. Technical grade is the standard commercial specification for these applications.

Bulk liquid supply in IBC containers and tanker quantities is the norm for high-volume industrial procurement, ensuring consistent availability for large-scale water treatment facilities.

name: Ammonium lauryl sulfate
description:
Ammonium lauryl sulfate ( CAS 2235-54-3 ), commonly abbreviated as ALS, is an anionic surfactant used across personal care and industrial formulations. It delivers strong foaming, emulsification, and cleansing performance at competitive cost.

Formulators select it as an alternative to sodium lauryl sulfate where lower pH sensitivity or specific viscosity profiles are required. In personal care, ALS is the primary active in shampoos, body washes, and liquid hand soaps.

It generates dense, stable foam and removes oils and residues effectively. Industrial cleaning formulations use it as a degreasing base in hard-surface cleaners and equipment wash products for professional maintenance.

Coating and printing applications rely on ALS as a dispersing and wetting agent to stabilize pigment suspensions and improve substrate adhesion. This ensures consistent application across various industrial surfaces.

Adhesive and sealant manufacturers incorporate it during emulsion polymerization to control particle size and stabilize latex systems. This chemical is supplied as an aqueous solution, most commonly at 28–30% active content.

Higher-concentration grades are available for specific industrial applications. Standard grades include cosmetic and personal care quality meeting relevant purity benchmarks, as well as technical grade for industrial use.

Packaging ranges from drums and IBCs to bulk tanker delivery for high-volume buyers. Our supply chain ensures that all batches meet rigorous quality control standards for consistency and performance in every application.

name: Ammonium cocoyl isethionate
description:
Ammonium cocoyl isethionate (CAS 223705-57-5 ), commercially available as Jordapon ACI 30 and Jordapon ACI 30G, is a mild, coconut-derived anionic surfactant used as a primary cleansing agent. Its low irritation profile makes it a preferred alternative to sulfate-based surfactants for sensitive-skin product lines.

In rinse-off personal care, it functions as the primary surfactant in solid and liquid cleansers, shampoo bars, and baby wash formulations where mildness is a key requirement. Body wash and facial cleanser manufacturers use it to achieve dense, stable lather without harshness.

In syndets, it provides the structural and cleansing backbone, enabling soap-free bar formats with a defined pH range suited to skin compatibility. Home care formulators incorporate it into mild dishwashing and surface cleaning products where skin contact is a design consideration.

Ammonium cocoyl isethionate is supplied in two principal commercial forms: as a liquid dispersion (Jordapon ACI 30, approximately 30% active) and as a granular solid (Jordapon ACI 30G). The latter is preferred for solid bar manufacturing.

Both forms are available in cosmetic and personal care grade meeting industry quality standards for use in finished consumer products. This surfactant is highly valued for its ability to maintain high performance while ensuring consumer safety and skin comfort.

The material is compatible with a wide range of other surfactants, allowing for versatile formulation strategies in both liquid and solid formats. Its biodegradable nature also supports the development of environmentally conscious cleaning products.

name: Malpighia glabra extract
description:
Malpighia glabra extract (CAS 223747-63-5 ), commonly sourced from the acerola cherry, is a standardized botanical extract concentrated for its naturally occurring vitamin C content. It functions as a natural antioxidant and nutrient source across food, cosmetic, and nutraceutical applications.

In functional food and dietary supplement manufacturing, it is used to fortify products with natural vitamin C, appealing to clean-label formulations where synthetic ascorbic acid is not preferred. This extract is a popular choice for premium health products.

Nutraceutical producers incorporate it into capsules, gummies, and powdered drink mixes targeting immune support positioning. In personal care, it is used in serums and topical formulations where naturally derived antioxidant activity supports skin defense.

Pharmaceutical and health product manufacturers also source it for standardized botanical ingredient applications requiring documented vitamin C equivalency. It meets rigorous industry requirements for purity and potency in various formulations.

Malpighia glabra extract is supplied as a spray-dried powder, the most common form for blending and encapsulation processes. It is available in standardized grades specifying vitamin C content, typically ranging from 17% to 25% natural ascorbic acid.

Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are both commercially available, with documentation supporting use under relevant regional regulatory frameworks. Quality control ensures the extract meets high standards for safety and efficacy.

name: Amaranthus caudatus extract
description:
Amaranthus caudatus extract (CAS 223747-79-3 ), also sourced and traded as amaranth oil, is a plant-derived ingredient obtained from the seeds of the love-lies-bleeding plant.

It delivers moisturizing and antioxidant activity across cosmetic, nutritional, and pharmaceutical formulations. In skincare and haircare products, it functions as a humectant and conditioning agent.

The extract supports moisture retention in creams, serums, and leave-on treatments. Nutritional supplement manufacturers incorporate it for its peptide and amino acid content for plant-based protein enrichment.

In functional food formulations, it contributes antioxidant activity that can extend shelf stability while supporting a clean-label ingredient profile for various consumer markets.

Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical developers also evaluate it as a bioactive carrier in softgel and encapsulated formats. Amaranthus caudatus extract is available as a liquid oil extract or dry powder.

Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commonly supplied, with some producers offering cold-pressed oil variants for premium personal care applications.

name: Argan oil
description:
Argan oil (CAS 223747-87-3 ), also traded under the botanical extract designation Argania spinosa, ext., is a premium plant-derived oil cold-pressed from the kernels of the Moroccan argan tree.

In personal care and food markets, it functions as a moisturizing carrier oil and nutritive emollient, delivering high concentrations of unsaturated fatty acids and tocopherols that support skin conditioning.

In cosmetic formulations, argan oil is incorporated into hair serums, facial oils, and leave-in conditioners where it reduces moisture loss and improves surface texture without heavy residue.

Skincare manufacturers use it as a carrier or co-emollient in creams and lotions, often replacing heavier oils to achieve lighter sensory profiles for high-end consumer products.

In food applications, culinary-grade argan oil is used as a specialty finishing oil and ingredient in dressings and confectionery, commanding premium positioning in gourmet and health-oriented lines.

Coatings and sealant formulators source it as a bio-based drying oil component where renewable raw material content is a procurement or compliance requirement for industrial sustainability.

Argan oil is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. Standard grades include cosmetic-grade, food-grade, and organic-certified variants, with the food and cosmetic grades differentiated by processing.

Supply is available in drums and IBCs, with cold-pressed and roasted variants relevant to food versus cosmetic sourcing decisions to ensure the highest quality and performance standards.

name: Tamanu oil
description:
Tamanu oil (CAS 223748-12-7 ), derived from the nuts of Calophyllum inophyllum, is a cold-pressed botanical oil used extensively in skin care and topical formulations.

Known in trade as Calophyllum tacamahaca extract, it is valued by formulators for its skin-regenerative and wound-healing properties in cosmetic and pharmaceutical applications.

In personal care, it is incorporated into facial serums, scar treatment creams, and after-sun products where it supports skin repair and barrier restoration for the user.

Pharmaceutical topical formulations use it as a functional carrier oil in ointments targeting dermatological conditions. Hair care manufacturers include it in scalp treatments and masks.

These conditioning masks address dryness and damage effectively. At lower inclusion levels, it also appears in premium nutraceutical and food supplement formulations for various brands.

The oil is supplied as a dark green to amber viscous liquid, typically in cold-pressed, unrefined form or as a refined grade for applications requiring reduced color and odor.

Standard supply grades include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications, with organic-certified material available for brands targeting natural and clean-label positioning in the market.

It is commonly offered in quantities ranging from small drums to bulk IBC containers to meet the diverse logistical needs of global chemical and cosmetic manufacturers.

name: Schisandra chinensis extract
description:
Schisandra chinensis extract (CAS 223748-53-6 ), also marketed as Schizandra chinensis extract, is a standardized botanical extract derived from the dried berries of the five-flavor fruit plant.

It is used across food, nutraceutical, and cosmetic formulations primarily for its antioxidant activity and adaptogenic positioning. In functional food and beverage products, it serves as both a natural flavoring agent and an antioxidant stabilizer.

The extract contributes a complex tart-bitter profile to various formulations. Nutraceutical manufacturers incorporate it into capsules, tablets, and softgels targeting stress support and liver health positioning.

These categories currently experience strong retail demand. In cosmetic and skincare formulations, it is used as an antioxidant active to support anti-aging and skin-brightening product claims for high-end brands.

Pharmaceutical and dietary supplement producers also source it for standardized lignans content, particularly schisandrin, as a marker compound for quality and efficacy alignment across global markets.

The material is supplied as a fine powder, typically spray-dried or water-extracted, and is available in standardized grades specifying schisandrin or total lignans content for precise dosing.

Common specifications include 1%, 2%, 9%, and higher schisandrin concentrations to meet formulation and label claim requirements. Both food-grade and supplement-grade material is available for industrial use.

Documentation including COA, heavy metals testing, and pesticide residue reports is standard for botanical extracts. This ensures compliance with international safety and quality standards for chemical distribution.

name: Tabebuia impetiginosa extract
description:
Tabebuia impetiginosa extract (CAS 223748-85-4 ), derived from the inner bark of the pink lapacho tree, is a standardized botanical extract recognized in cosmetic and nutraceutical sourcing under the common name pau d'arco extract.

It delivers antioxidant activity and bioactive compound content, primarily naphthoquinones, that drives its commercial value across personal care, food supplement, and pharmaceutical applications.

In cosmetic formulations, it is incorporated into anti-aging creams, serums, and scalp treatments where antioxidant stabilization and skin-conditioning performance are required for high-end product lines.

Nutraceutical manufacturers use it in capsule and tablet formats targeting immune support and antioxidant supplementation. Food and beverage producers apply it as a functional botanical ingredient in health-oriented teas.

Pharmaceutical and OTC formulators source it as a standardized herbal active for inclusion in botanical drug products and traditional herbal medicine preparations requiring consistent potency and purity levels.

Tabebuia impetiginosa extract is supplied as a dry powder or spray-dried extract, typically standardized to naphthoquinone content. Cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications are the most commonly available.

The material is selected based on standardization level and intended application, ensuring that manufacturers receive a product that meets rigorous quality control and safety benchmarks for global distribution.

name: Yucca schidigera extract
description:
Yucca schidigera extract (CAS 223749-05-1 ), also referred to commercially as Yucca Root Leaf Extract, is a plant-derived concentrate obtained from the Mojave yucca plant. It functions primarily as a natural foaming agent, surfactant, and flavor modifier across food, feed, and personal care markets.

In animal feed and livestock production, it reduces ammonia and hydrogen sulfide emissions in waste, improving air quality in confined feeding operations. Food and beverage manufacturers use it as a natural foaming agent in root beer, cocktail mixers, and other carbonated beverages.

Where stable foam is a product requirement, this extract provides a reliable solution. In pet food formulations, it is incorporated as an odor-control additive that acts within the digestive system to improve the environment for both pets and owners.

Polyacrylate-4 (CAS 228863-31-8 ) is a synthetic acrylic polymer used in personal care and industrial formulations to control flow behavior and modify surface interactions. It enables formulators to achieve precise viscosity profiles and improve the sensory or functional performance of finished products.

In skin care and color cosmetics, this polymer functions as a rheology modifier that builds viscosity in emulsions, gels, and serums without compromising skin feel. Sunscreen and leave-on formulations benefit from its ability to suspend active ingredients.

The material helps maintain product stability across temperature cycles, ensuring a consistent shelf life for consumer goods. In coatings, it supports controlled flow and leveling during application, reducing sagging in architectural and industrial paint systems.

Adhesive and sealant manufacturers use it to tune open time and application consistency in water-based systems. This versatility makes it a staple ingredient for technical formulators looking for reliable thickening and stabilization properties.

The product is typically supplied as a liquid dispersion or emulsion, ready for direct incorporation into aqueous formulations. Cosmetic-grade material is the primary commercial form, aligned with INCI usage in personal care applications.

Industrial grades suited for coatings and adhesive systems are also available, with concentration and pH specifications varying by supplier. These grades ensure compatibility with a wide range of chemical environments and manufacturing processes.

name: Methyltris(methylethylketoxime)silane
description:
Methyltris(methylethylketoxime)silane (CAS 22984-54-9 ) is an oxime-functional silane used as a crosslinker and curing agent in silicone-based systems. It releases methyl ethyl ketoxime upon moisture exposure.

This reaction enables room-temperature vulcanization without requiring heat or catalyst activation. Its primary use is in one-component (1K) RTV silicone sealants, where it controls cure speed and mechanical properties.

The chemical determines the final characteristics of the cured bead, which is critical for construction, glazing, and automotive assembly applications. In silicone adhesives, it functions as a crosslinker.

This crosslinking determines network density, directly affecting elongation and tensile strength in the finished product. Coatings formulators incorporate it into silicone release coatings and conformal coatings.

It is utilized where controlled surface cure and adhesion to substrates are required. Personal care applications include silicone-based formulations where surface modification of inorganic fillers is necessary.

Conditioning agents also require this reactive silane chemistry for effective performance. The product is supplied as a clear liquid in standard industrial packaging, including drums and IBCs.

It is available in technical grade, with purity specifications typically at 97% or higher depending on the supplier. Moisture-sensitive handling requirements influence the specific packaging specifications.

Buyers should confirm shelf life and storage conditions when evaluating supply options. This ensures the material maintains its reactive properties throughout the duration of its intended industrial use.

name: Isopropyl lauroyl sarcosinate
description:
Isopropyl lauroyl sarcosinate (CAS 230309-38-3 ), commercially known as Eldew SL-205, is an ester-based amino acid derivative used in personal care and pharmaceutical formulations.

It functions simultaneously as an emollient, dispersant, and solubility enhancer, reducing the need for multiple functional ingredients in a single system. In skin and hair care, it improves spreadability.

This ingredient is ideal for anhydrous formulations such as cleansing oils, serums, and leave-on treatments while contributing a non-greasy skin feel. Formulators use it in color cosmetics to disperse pigments.

It is frequently used in lipstick bases, foundations, and eye products, replacing conventional ester solvents. In sunscreen formulations, it aids UV filter solubilization and improves the texture of high-SPF systems.

Pharmaceutical topical preparations benefit from its carrier properties, supporting active ingredient delivery in ointment and cream bases. It is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid for industrial use.

It is available in cosmetic-grade specification, with Eldew SL-205 being the most recognized commercial grade. Packaging typically follows standard industrial formats for large-scale operations.

Bulk supply is available for manufacturers requiring consistent quality and performance. This versatile ester remains a staple for high-performance personal care and pharmaceutical topical applications.

name: C18-Ceramide
description:
C18-Ceramide (CAS 2304-81-6 ), also known as N-stearoyl-D-erythro-sphingosine, is a naturally occurring sphingolipid that mirrors the ceramide species found in human skin. It functions as a structural lipid and moisture-retention agent.

This compound reinforces the skin barrier in cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations. In prestige and clinical skincare, it is incorporated into barrier-repair creams, serums, and emulsions where it replenishes lipids.

It is essential for restoring depleted intercellular lipids in the stratum corneum. Pharmaceutical topical formulations targeting dry skin conditions such as eczema and psoriasis use it to restore lamellar lipid structure.

The material is highly effective at reducing transepidermal water loss in clinical applications. In liposomal and nanoparticle drug delivery systems, its membrane-forming properties support encapsulation efficiency.

These properties also allow for the controlled release of active compounds in advanced medicine. Biotechnology and life sciences researchers use it as a reference lipid standard and as a functional component.

It is frequently utilized in cell membrane studies and other specialized laboratory applications. This product is supplied as a white to off-white powder or waxy solid for industrial and research use.

It is available in cosmetic-grade and research-grade specifications, with purity levels typically ranging from 95% to 99%+ for high-performance formulation use and laboratory testing.

Packaging options generally range from small quantities for laboratory use to larger bulk formats for industrial formulators. We ensure all batches meet rigorous internal quality control protocols.

name: Octyl caprylate
description:
Octyl caprylate (CAS 2306-88-9 ), also known as octyl octanoate, is a synthetic ester produced from caprylic acid and octanol. Registered under FEMA 2811 , it functions as an emollient, lubricant, and solvent carrier.

This versatile chemical serves as a flavoring agent across personal care, food, and industrial applications. In personal care formulations, it acts as a lightweight emollient and solvent carrier for active ingredients.

It is commonly found in skin creams, sunscreens, and color cosmetics. Food and flavor manufacturers use it as a FEMA-approved flavoring ingredient, contributing fatty, creamy top notes to various products.

It is frequently utilized in confectionery, dairy, and beverage products. Industrial lubricant formulators incorporate it as a base fluid or additive in metalworking fluids and specialty lubricants.

These applications are ideal where low viscosity and good lubricity are required. It also functions as a solvent for fragrance compounds and lipophilic actives in both rinse-off and leave-on systems.

Octyl caprylate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid in drum and IBC quantities. Food-grade material meeting specific standards is available for flavor applications to ensure safety.

Cosmetic and technical grades serve personal care and industrial end uses. Purity levels typically range from 98% upward depending on the intended application and specific customer requirements.

name: Isoamyl decanoate
description:
Isoamyl decanoate (CAS 2306-91-4 ), also known as isopentyl decanoate, is a medium-chain fatty acid ester used as a flavoring agent and emollient carrier in food and cosmetic applications.

It delivers a mild, fruity character that blends cleanly into complex flavor and fragrance systems. Its ester structure also makes it effective as a non-polar solvent and carrier for active ingredients.

In food flavoring, isoamyl decanoate contributes fruity, waxy top notes to confectionery, beverages, and dairy formulations where low-intensity background esters are required for the profile.

Cosmetic formulators use it as a skin-feel modifier and carrier oil in serums, sunscreens, and color cosmetics, where it improves spreadability without leaving a heavy residue on the skin.

It functions as a solvent for lipophilic fragrance compounds in perfumery, helping to dissolve and stabilize aromatic blends in leave-on and rinse-off products for various consumer goods.

In lipstick and lip gloss bases, it acts as a diluent for pigment dispersions and wax systems. Isoamyl decanoate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid for industrial use.

Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the standard commercial offerings, with food-grade material typically produced to purity levels meeting flavor industry requirements for safety.

Packaging ranges from small drums to IBCs depending on volume requirements. The material should be stored in a cool, dry place to maintain its chemical stability and shelf life.

description:

In metalworking and industrial cleaning, it is assessed as a degreasing solvent for removing oils, greases, and machining residues from metal components. Electronics manufacturing processes that require precision cleaning of circuit boards represent another area of technical interest.

Lubricant formulators have examined it as a carrier solvent where brominated chemistry is required for specific performance profiles. Home care and industrial cleaning product developers may evaluate it as a functional solvent component in heavy-duty formulations.

The chemical is supplied as a liquid and is available primarily in technical grade for industrial and research applications. Packaging typically ranges from laboratory quantities to bulk supply, depending on sourcing channel and end-use requirements.

name: Nicotinamide riboside chloride
description:
Nicotinamide riboside chloride (CAS 23111-00-4 ), commonly abbreviated as NR-Cl, is the chloride salt form of nicotinamide riboside. It is a bioavailable precursor to NAD+ used across nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic manufacturing.

It functions as a cellular coenzyme precursor, supporting NAD+ biosynthesis in finished formulations targeting metabolic and longevity-related applications. In dietary supplements, it is the active ingredient in NAD+ precursor capsules.

NR-Cl is also utilized in tablets and powdered drink formats marketed for energy metabolism and healthy aging. Pharmaceutical manufacturers incorporate it into formulations where precise NAD+ pathway modulation is required.

In cosmetic and personal care formulations, it is used in anti-aging serums and topical treatments. This NAD+ precursor activity supports skin cell renewal and moisture retention in high-end skincare products.

Sports nutrition and wellness brands also use NR-Cl in premium blend powders targeting cellular energy and recovery claims. It is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder for various industrial uses.

It is available in pharmaceutical-grade and food-grade specifications, with USP and FCC grades recognized in commercial supply chains. These standards ensure high purity for sensitive manufacturing processes.

Packaging typically ranges from small research quantities up to bulk kilogram lots to serve both development-scale and commercial production needs. This flexibility supports both pilot studies and large-scale market distribution.

name: 4-octylphenol monoethoxylate
description:
4-Octylphenol monoethoxylate (CAS 2315-67-5 ) is a short-chain ethoxylated alkylphenol surfactant used as an emulsifier, dispersant, and cleaning agent across industrial formulations.

It is a low-ethoxylate member of the alkylphenol ethoxylate family, distinct from longer-chain variants such as Triton X-100, and is relevant to buyers sourcing controlled or specific EO-count intermediates.

In agrochemical formulations, it functions as an emulsifier and carrier in pesticide emulsifiable concentrates, improving active ingredient dispersion in water for better application.

Textile processors use it in scouring and dyeing auxiliaries, where it aids in fiber wetting and removal of oils and sizing agents during the manufacturing process.

In leather processing, it supports degreasing baths and fat-liquoring emulsions that require controlled HLB surfactants to ensure consistent quality and material penetration.

Personal care formulators evaluate it as a solubilizer or emulsification aid in rinse-off systems where low-ethoxylate alkylphenols are technically specified for the formulation.

The product is supplied as a liquid at standard commercial concentrations. It is available in technical grade, with supply typically in drums or IBC containers suited to industrial procurement volumes.

Buyers should confirm ethylene oxide adduct count and purity specification with the supplier, as these factors directly affect the HLB value and the specific application fit.

name: Propyl benzoate
description:
Propyl benzoate ( CAS 2315-68-6 ), also identified under FEMA 2931 , is an ester used commercially as both a flavoring agent and a functional solvent in food and cosmetic formulations.

It delivers a characteristic fruity, floral note that positions it as a building block in flavor and fragrance compounding. In flavor creation, it contributes cherry, rose, and fruity nuances to confectionery.

These applications extend to beverages and baked goods, where precise ester character is required. Fragrance houses use it as a carrier and modifier in floral and oriental fragrance compositions.

This material improves diffusion and blending performance of other aroma materials. In personal care, it functions as a solvent and emollient carrier in formulations such as lip products and skin creams.

It is also utilized in hair care preparations where oil-phase compatibility is needed. Its solvency profile supports the dissolution of fragrance raw materials and active ingredients during manufacturing.

Propyl benzoate is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes. It is available in food-grade quality compliant with FEMA-recognized standards.

name: Ditrimethylolpropane
description:
Ditrimethylolpropane ( CAS 23235-61-2 ), also referred to as di-TMP, is a tetrafunctional polyol derived from trimethylolpropane. Its four hydroxyl groups make it a reactive building block for producing high-crosslink-density polymers.

This chemical is essential for manufacturing esters and resins across coatings, lubricants, and adhesive systems. In synthetic lubricant manufacturing, di-TMP is esterified with fatty acids or complex acid blends.

This process produces high-performance polyol ester base fluids with strong thermal stability. Such stability is a key requirement for compressor and aviation lubricant formulations used in demanding industrial environments.

Radiation-curable and high-solids coating systems use it as a crosslinker and backbone polyol. Its functionality delivers harder films and improved chemical resistance compared to lower-functional alternatives.

Adhesive and sealant formulators incorporate di-TMP into polyurethane and polyester systems to increase crosslink density. This allows for better control over flexibility and structural integrity in the final product.

In UV-curable inks for packaging applications, it contributes to fast cure response and adhesion to demanding substrates. This makes it a preferred choice for high-speed printing and specialized industrial labeling.

Ditrimethylolpropane is supplied as a white crystalline solid or powder. Standard commercial grades include technical and industrial purity levels, typically at 98% minimum assay for consistent performance.

Packaging is available in bags or drums suited to bulk industrial procurement. Our logistics team ensures that all shipments meet the necessary safety and handling requirements for global distribution and storage.

name: Sodium dicyclohexyl sulfosuccinate
description:
Sodium dicyclohexyl sulfosuccinate (CAS 23386-52-9 ) is an anionic surfactant from the sulfosuccinate family, valued for its strong wetting and dispersing performance across industrial and specialty formulations.

Its diester structure with cyclohexyl groups delivers effective surface tension reduction in systems where conventional surfactants underperform. In water treatment, it functions as a wetting agent and dispersant.

This chemical improves penetration and particle suspension in treatment formulations. Personal care and cosmetic manufacturers incorporate it into cleansing and emulsified products where controlled foam is required.

Uniform dispersion is essential for these applications. In printing and packaging, it aids ink wetting and substrate adhesion, improving print quality on difficult surfaces and specialized materials.

Textile, leather, and paper processing operations use it to enhance fiber penetration during dyeing, tanning, and coating steps. This reduces processing time and improves overall product uniformity.

Sodium dicyclohexyl sulfosuccinate is typically supplied as a liquid solution or paste. Technical grade is the standard commercial form for industrial applications, with concentration levels varying by supplier.

End-use requirements dictate the specific concentration needed for each process. Packaging options generally range from drums to intermediate bulk containers, suited to industrial procurement volumes.
