name: Denatonium benzoate
description:
Denatonium benzoate (CAS 3734-33-6 ), also known commercially as Bitrex, is recognized as the most intensely bitter substance known. It is used industrially as an aversive agent to prevent accidental ingestion of hazardous or non-consumable products.

At concentrations as low as a few parts per million, it renders products unpalatable without affecting their functional performance. In pharmaceuticals and healthcare, it is added to topical formulations and rubbing alcohols.

These applications discourage oral ingestion of products not intended for consumption. Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into nail-biting deterrent products and hand sanitizers where accidental ingestion is a safety concern.

Industrial formulators use it to denature ethanol and other solvents, satisfying regulatory requirements for denatured alcohol without altering solvent performance. It also appears in household and consumer product formulations.

Common applications include antifreeze, detergents, and cleaning agents to protect children and animals from accidental poisoning. Denatonium benzoate anhydrous is the standard commercial form, supplied as a white crystalline powder.

It is available in pharmaceutical-grade specifications meeting USP and BP standards, as well as technical grade for industrial denaturation applications. Typical supply quantities range from small packs to bulk quantities.

These bulk quantities are suited for large-scale formulation or blending operations. The material remains stable under standard storage conditions and provides a cost-effective solution for safety compliance in various industries.

name: Acid red 1
description:
Acid Red 1 (CAS 3734-67-6 ), also known commercially as Red 2G and E128 , is a synthetic azo dye used to impart bright red coloration across a range of industrial and formerly food-related applications.

It functions as an anionic colorant with strong affinity for protein and polyamide substrates, making it a practical choice for dye bath and solution-based coloring processes.

In textile dyeing, this compound is applied to wool, silk, and nylon fabrics to achieve consistent, level red shades with good wash performance. Leather processors use it in finishing baths to produce uniform surface color on tanned hides.

In printing inks and packaging applications, it contributes to red and pink tones in water-based ink formulations. Coatings and adhesive formulators incorporate it where solution-stable red coloration is required in aqueous systems.

The product is supplied as a fine powder or granule, typically in commercial dye grades suited to textile and industrial use. Standard offerings are characterized by dye content specifications rather than pharmacopeial grades.

Purity levels are commonly expressed as a percentage of active colorant. Packaging ranges from small technical quantities to bulk industrial supply, ensuring flexibility for various manufacturing scales and requirements.

name: Sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropanesulfonate-sodium acrylate polymer
description:
Sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropanesulfonate-sodium acrylate polymer (CAS 37350-42-8 ) is an anionic copolymer used across water treatment, personal care, and industrial applications for rheology control.

It is commercially available in emulsion form as sodium acrylate/sodium acryloyldimethyl taurate (ATBS) copolymer, often blended with mineral oil and trideceth-6 for direct formulation use.

In water treatment, the polymer functions as a flocculant and dispersant, improving solids separation in municipal and industrial effluent processes. It provides excellent performance in diverse conditions.

Personal care formulators use the ATBS copolymer emulsion grade to build viscosity and stabilize emulsions in creams, lotions, and sunscreens without requiring high shear mixing during the process.

Home care and industrial cleaning products rely on it to suspend particles and maintain formula stability across a wide pH range. This versatility makes it a staple in modern chemical manufacturing.

In textile and paper processing, it acts as a retention and drainage aid, improving fiber binding and reducing raw material loss during production. This enhances overall efficiency and output quality.

The polymer is supplied as an aqueous dispersion or oil-in-water emulsion, with the pre-blended mineral oil and trideceth-6 format being standard for cosmetic applications and general use.

Technical and industrial grades are available for water treatment and process industries. Purity and active content specifications vary by grade, with cosmetic-grade material typically conforming to standards.

name: Disopyramide
description:
Disopyramide (CAS 3737-09-5 ) is an active pharmaceutical ingredient used in the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias. It functions as a Class Ia antiarrhythmic agent, suppressing abnormal electrical activity in the heart muscle.

This compound helps to restore and maintain normal sinus rhythm in patients. It is the primary API in finished oral dosage forms, including capsules and extended-release tablets, indicated for ventricular and supraventricular arrhythmias.

Pharmaceutical manufacturers source this material as a key input for formulating branded and generic antiarrhythmic drug products. It is also used in hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy management to reduce outflow tract obstruction.

The clinical utility of this substance expands its relevance beyond standard arrhythmia indications. Research and reference standard laboratories procure small quantities for analytical method development and pharmacokinetic studies.

The material is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. It is available in pharmaceutical-grade specifications, including USP and BP / Ph.Eur. grades, to meet the quality requirements of regulated drug manufacturing.

The phosphate salt form, Disopyramide Phosphate, is the more commonly used variant in finished dosage formulations. This salt is also available under corresponding pharmacopoeial standards such as EP for global distribution.

name: Calcium thioglycolate
description:
Calcium thioglycolate (CAS 37457-75-3 ) is the calcium salt of thioglycolic acid, used primarily as a depilatory and hair-waving agent in personal care formulations. It breaks disulfide bonds in keratin, enabling controlled hair removal.

This chemical allows for restructuring without the use of strongly alkaline thioglycolate alternatives. In cosmetic depilatory creams and lotions, it disrupts the protein structure of hair at the skin surface.

This process allows clean removal with minimal irritation compared to sodium or potassium thioglycolate. Cold wave and permanent wave formulations use it as the active reducing agent to reshape the disulfide bond network.

In textile processing, it functions as a reducing agent for wool treatments, improving fiber softness and receptivity to dyeing. Leather processing operations employ it during the unhairing stage to loosen hair.

This application helps remove the epidermis from hides before tanning. Calcium thioglycolate is supplied as a white to off-white powder or as an aqueous solution at varying active concentrations for industrial use.

Cosmetic-grade material is the most commonly traded specification, with purity levels typically documented to meet formulator requirements. Technical-grade product is available for industrial textile and leather applications.

These industrial versions are suitable where cosmetic compliance is not required. The material is handled according to standard safety protocols for reducing agents to ensure stability and performance in final products.

name: Rubixanthin
description:
Rubixanthin (CAS 3763-55-1 ), also marketed as Natural Yellow 27 and approved under E161d , is a carotenoid pigment derived from rose hips. It delivers yellow-to-orange coloration in food, cosmetic, and nutritional applications.

Its natural origin positions it as a preferred alternative to synthetic colorants in clean-label and regulated markets. In food and beverage manufacturing, it functions as a natural colorant in products such as confectionery and dairy.

The material is used in beverages where E161d approval supports EU market compliance. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into skincare and color cosmetics to provide pigmentation alongside antioxidant stabilization of the formula.

In nutritional supplements, it is used as both a colorant and a carotenoid active in softgels and capsules targeting antioxidant positioning. Animal feed producers apply it to enhance the pigmentation of poultry skin and egg yolks.

Carotenoid deposition is a measurable quality parameter in these agricultural applications. Rubixanthin is supplied as a powder or oil suspension, with concentration standardized to defined carotenoid content for industrial use.

Food-grade material conforming to E161d specifications is the primary commercial form. Availability can be limited relative to more abundant carotenoids, so buyers should confirm supply continuity before committing.

Batch documentation should be reviewed during formulation development to ensure consistency. This specialty pigment remains a niche but vital component for manufacturers seeking specific natural yellow-to-orange hues in their product lines.

name: Melamine cyanurate
description:
Melamine cyanurate ( CAS 37640-57-6 ), commonly abbreviated as MCA, is a halogen-free flame retardant formed from the equimolar complex of melamine and cyanuric acid. It is used across plastics and textiles to meet fire safety standards.

This chemical is utilized in engineered materials to avoid the regulatory concerns associated with halogenated systems. In polyamide compounds, MCA is the dominant flame retardant additive, enabling UL 94 V-0 ratings at low loading levels.

It is effective in both glass-filled and unfilled grades of nylon. Textile and fiber applications use MCA to impart durable flame resistance in technical fabrics for automotive interiors, workwear, and aerospace seating components.

In building and construction, it is incorporated into coatings, sealants, and insulation materials. These applications require fire performance alongside low smoke and toxicity targets to ensure safety in residential and commercial structures.

Engineered thermoplastic formulations for electrical and electronic components also rely on MCA. This is particularly important where halogen-free compliance is a procurement or regulatory requirement for global manufacturing standards.

Melamine cyanurate is supplied as a white powder with particle size distributions optimized for different compounding processes. Technical and polymer grades are the most common commercial forms available for industrial use.

Specifications are typically defined by purity, d50 particle size, and bulk density. Surface-treated variants are available for improved dispersion in polyamide and other polymer matrices to ensure consistent material performance.

name: 2-(tert-butylamino)ethyl methacrylate
description:
2-(tert-Butylamino)ethyl methacrylate (CAS 3775-90-4 ), also known commercially as Ageflex FM-4, is a functional methacrylate monomer carrying a secondary amine group.

It is used to introduce amine functionality into polymer backbones, enabling controlled reactivity for adhesion, crosslinking, and surface modification in coating and polymer systems.

In automotive and industrial coatings, it is incorporated into acrylic copolymers to improve adhesion to metal substrates and facilitate crosslinking with epoxy or isocyanate curatives.

Adhesive and sealant formulators use it to build amine-functional resins where controlled cure response and substrate bonding are critical performance requirements for industrial use.

In printing inks and packaging coatings, copolymerization with this monomer improves ink adhesion and film cohesion on difficult substrates during the manufacturing process.

Plastics compounders and polymer producers also use it as a reactive building block for designing pH-responsive or amine-functional specialty polymers for various applications.

The product is supplied as a liquid monomer, typically with an inhibitor package to maintain stability during storage and transport. It is available in technical grade for industrial use.

Bulk and drum quantities are standard supply formats for industrial buyers, with sample quantities available for formulation development and testing in laboratory environments.

name: Tetrasodium etidronate
description:
Tetrasodium etidronate (CAS 3794-83-0 ), also marketed as Turpinal 4NL and Sequion 10Na4 and abbreviated HEDP·4Na, is the fully neutralized tetrasodium salt of 1-hydroxyethylidene-1,1-diphosphonic acid.

It functions as a high-performance chelating and sequestering agent, binding calcium, magnesium, and heavy metal ions to prevent scale formation, oxidative degradation, and corrosion across industrial applications.

In personal care formulations, it stabilizes hydrogen peroxide in hair bleaching and coloring products, extending shelf life and preventing premature decomposition during storage and use.

Water treatment operations use it to inhibit scale deposition and corrosion in cooling towers, boilers, and process water circuits. This ensures operational efficiency and longevity of the equipment.

Textile and paper processing facilities apply it to sequester hardness ions during bleaching and dyeing, preventing metal-catalyzed fiber damage and improving overall process consistency and quality.

In oil and gas production, it controls mineral scale in pipelines and injection systems where calcium carbonate and phosphate deposits restrict flow. This helps maintain optimal production rates.

The product is supplied as a clear to pale yellow aqueous solution, typically at 35–40% active content. Technical and industrial grades are the standard market offering for most applications.

Cosmetic-grade material is available to meet personal care formulation requirements. Packaging ranges from drums to IBC containers depending on specific volume requirements and logistics needs.

name: Phosphonobutane tricarboxylic acid
description:
Phosphonobutane tricarboxylic acid ( CAS 37971-36-1 ), commonly abbreviated as PBTC, is a phosphonate-based organic acid used across water treatment and industrial process chemistry. It functions primarily as a scale inhibitor, corrosion inhibitor, and chelating agent.

This chemical is essential for controlling mineral deposits and metal ion activity in aqueous systems. In industrial water treatment, including cooling water circuits and boiler systems, PBTC inhibits calcium carbonate and calcium sulfate scale formation.

It is also effective against calcium phosphate scale at low dosage rates. Its chelating capacity makes it effective in textile processing, where it sequesters hardness ions during dyeing and bleaching to prevent interference with colorants.

In construction chemical formulations, PBTC acts as a retarder and dispersant in cement and gypsum-based systems. This improves workability and set control, while personal care formulators use it to stabilize products against metal-induced degradation.

The compound is also utilized to buffer pH in aqueous product systems across various manufacturing sectors. PBTC is supplied as an aqueous solution, most commonly at fifty percent active content for industrial applications.

Technical grade is the standard market offering, with purity and concentration verified by titration or ICP methods. Bulk liquid supply in IBC containers or tankers is typical for industrial procurement volumes and logistics.

name: 9-methoxy-9-borabicyclo[3.3.1]nonane
description:
9-Methoxy-9-borabicyclo[3.3.1]nonane (CAS 38050-71-4 ), commonly referenced as 9-MeO-9-BBN or B-methoxy-9-BBN, is a stabilized organoborane reagent used in synthetic chemistry. It serves as a controlled source of the reactive 9-BBN boron center for various industrial applications.

Its primary commercial role is enabling selective hydroboration and cross-coupling reactions under conditions that demand greater handling stability than the parent 9-BBN hydride. This makes it a preferred choice for large-scale chemical processing.

In pharmaceutical synthesis, it functions as a precursor to boronate esters and boronic acids used in Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling steps. These steps are vital during active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) manufacture for global supply chains.

Contract research organizations and process chemistry teams use it when building complex carbon frameworks where regioselectivity is critical. It ensures reproducibility across batches, which must be documented according to strict industry protocols.

In biotechnology workflows, it supports the preparation of boron-tagged intermediates for probe synthesis and labeling chemistry. Industrial cleaning formulations incorporating boron-based catalytic systems may also utilize it as a catalyst precursor.

The reagent is often used in specialized surface-treatment or polymerization-adjacent processes. It is supplied as a liquid or solution in standard organic solvents such as THF or hexanes, with concentration typically specified by the supplier.

Available in research quantities through to multi-kilogram lots for process-scale pharmaceutical manufacturing. Technical and synthesis-grade specifications are standard for this material to ensure consistent performance in the laboratory.

Buyers should confirm purity by NMR or GC assay per batch documentation provided by the manufacturer. This ensures the material meets the necessary requirements for high-precision chemical synthesis and industrial applications.

name: Climbazole
description:
Climbazole (CAS 38083-17-9 ), also known by the trade names Baypival and Crinipan AD, is an imidazole-based antifungal active used across personal care, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications.

It targets fungal growth, particularly Malassezia species, making it a standard active ingredient in anti-dandruff and scalp treatment formulations for various consumer products.

In personal care, this compound is incorporated into shampoos, conditioners, and scalp serums at low concentrations to control dandruff-causing fungi and maintain healthy scalp conditions.

Pharmaceutical formulators use it as an active or intermediate in topical antifungal preparations targeting dermatological conditions. It is highly effective in specialized medical skin care treatments.

In textile and leather processing, it functions as a biocide to prevent mold and fungal degradation during storage and finishing. This ensures the longevity and quality of raw materials.

Paper manufacturers apply it as a preservative treatment to protect against fungal spoilage in humid storage environments. This application is critical for maintaining structural integrity in industrial settings.

name: Imidazolidinyl urea

It is frequently paired with parabens or other preservatives to achieve broad-spectrum coverage at lower individual concentrations. This synergy ensures that liquid soaps and hair care products remain safe for consumer use over long periods.

Pharmaceutical topical preparations such as creams and gels rely on this preservative to maintain sterility standards during storage. It is particularly effective in environments where water activity creates a high risk for microbial proliferation.

Personal care manufacturers also utilize this ingredient in wet wipes and rinse-off products. Its stability in various formulations makes it a versatile choice for industrial formulators seeking reliable antimicrobial protection in diverse applications.

The material is supplied as a white powder in various grades. Standard options include cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade material, with the latter conforming to USP and BP specifications for quality and purity.

Bulk quantities are available for large-scale industrial formulators. Smaller packaging options are also provided to suit specific compounding needs or for quality assurance evaluation purposes in laboratory settings.

name: Sodium chloroacetate
description:
Sodium chloroacetate (CAS 3926-62-3 ), also sold as Monoxone and abbreviated SMCA, is the sodium salt form of chloroacetic acid used as a reactive intermediate and biocidal agent across chemical synthesis and industrial processing.

This is particularly important in the production of compounds requiring a chloroacetate alkylating step. Personal care formulators rely on it in the production of carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) and betaine-type surfactants.

These surfactants are commonly used in shampoos and skin cleansers. It functions as a selective herbicide intermediate in agrochemical synthesis, contributing to the manufacture of chloroacetic acid-based weed control actives.

Industrial buyers also source it as a biocidal agent for controlling microbial growth in specific process environments. Sodium chloroacetate is supplied as a white crystalline powder or granular solid for various applications.

Standard commercial grades include technical grade and pharmaceutical-grade material, with purity specifications typically ranging from 97% to 99%+. Packaging is available in bags and drums suited to bulk industrial procurement.

description:
Sulfadoxine mixture with trimethoprim (CAS 39295-60-8 ), also known as Tridoxine, is a fixed-ratio antibiotic combination pairing a long-acting sulfonamide with a dihydrofolate reductase inhibitor.

The combination is used across pharmaceutical manufacturing and veterinary sectors for its synergistic antimicrobial action against a broad spectrum of bacterial and protozoal targets.

In human pharmaceutical manufacturing, the combination serves as the active basis for antimalarial finished dosage forms, particularly tablets targeting Plasmodium falciparum in endemic regions.

Veterinary formulators incorporate it into oral and injectable preparations for the treatment of bacterial infections in livestock and poultry. It is a vital component for animal health.

In agricultural and feed applications, it functions as a therapeutic agent in medicated premixes targeting enteric and respiratory pathogens in production animals during large-scale operations.

Biotechnology and life sciences suppliers source it as a reference standard or research-grade material for antimicrobial susceptibility studies and assay development in laboratory settings.

Sulfadoxine mixture with trimethoprim is supplied as a solid powder. It is available in pharmaceutical-grade specifications aligned with established pharmacopoeial standards like USP and BP .

It improves texture consistency and is widely used by bakeries to extend shelf life and improve dough water retention. This functionality is essential for reducing staling in various breads and commercial baked goods.

In textile processing, it acts as a sizing and finishing agent, improving fiber cohesion and surface smoothness during fabric production. Leather and paper manufacturers apply it as a binding and coating agent to enhance finish.

name: Isopropyl citrate
description:

It functions primarily by binding metal ions that would otherwise catalyze oxidative degradation in fats, oils, and formulated products. In edible oils, margarines, and fat-based food products, it extends shelf life.

By sequestering pro-oxidant metals such as iron and copper, it protects flavor and color integrity. Personal care formulators incorporate it into creams, lotions, and lipstick bases where it stabilizes oil phases.

It prevents rancidity in emulsified systems and is used in lubricant and metalworking fluid formulations. It acts as a chelant to control metal contamination that would otherwise accelerate fluid breakdown.

It also functions as a synergist alongside primary antioxidants such as tocopherols, boosting their effectiveness at lower treat rates. Isopropyl citrate is typically supplied as a liquid or paste.

In epoxy coatings and flooring systems, this material delivers flexible, tough cured networks with improved impact resistance compared to rigid aromatic amine curatives used in industrial settings.

Adhesive and sealant formulators use it to tune pot life and elongation in structural and flexible bond lines, ensuring high mechanical performance and durability in various applications.

In polyurea and spray elastomer systems, it reacts with isocyanates to produce fast-setting, durable films for protective coatings and industrial linings across the manufacturing sector.

Plastics and polymer compounders also incorporate it as a chain extender or surface modifier to improve adhesion and compatibility at interfaces within complex chemical formulations.

Supplied as a low-viscosity liquid, this product is handled and shipped in drums and IBCs. It is available primarily in technical grade , consistent with industrial curing agent specifications.

description:
Metatartaric acid ( CAS 39469-81-3 ), also known as ditartaric acid and approved as E353 , is a condensation product of tartaric acid used primarily as a stabilizing agent in food and beverage processing.

These crystals would otherwise deposit as visible sediment in bottled wine. It is particularly valued in still wines and fruit wines where cold stabilization is impractical or cost-prohibitive for the producer.

In pharmaceutical formulations, it serves as a buffering and stabilizing agent in liquid preparations. This is essential where controlled acidity and inhibition of precipitation are required for the final product.

name: 2-Propynoxyethanol
description:
2-Propynoxyethanol (CAS 3973-18-0 ) is a bifunctional building block combining a terminal alkyne and a hydroxyl group within a single molecule. It is used in polymer chemistry to introduce reactive alkyne handles.

This chemical enables precise structural control during synthesis by introducing hydroxyl functionality into macromolecular architectures. In plastics and polymer manufacturing, it serves as a monomer or chain-end modifier.

In these systems, the hydroxyl group acts as the initiating species. Specialty coating and adhesive developers incorporate it when building polymer backbones that require post-synthesis surface modification.

This modification is achieved through alkyne-reactive coupling. The product is supplied as a liquid at standard commercial purity levels, typically 95–98%, suited for research-scale and specialty synthesis.

name: Isononyl acetate
description:
Isononyl acetate (CAS 40379-24-6 ), also known as 3,5,5-trimethylhexyl acetate, is an ester-based solvent and plasticizer used across coatings, adhesives, and personal care manufacturing. It combines slow evaporation characteristics with good solvency.

This chemical is a practical choice for formulations requiring controlled drying or film flexibility. In coatings and printing inks, it functions as a coalescing solvent and viscosity modifier, supporting film formation across a range of resin systems.

Adhesive and sealant formulators incorporate it as a plasticizing agent to improve flexibility and substrate adhesion in finished products. Personal care manufacturers use it as a carrier and emollient solvent in skin-feel formulations.

It is particularly useful where a dry, non-greasy texture is required. In packaging applications, it supports ink compatibility and helps regulate solvent release during high-speed printing processes, ensuring consistent quality.

Isononyl acetate is supplied as a clear liquid, typically in drum and IBC quantities for industrial buyers. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity specifications commonly at 99% or above.

Cosmetic-grade material is available for personal care applications where formulation documentation and supplier quality standards are a procurement consideration. This ensures compliance with various industrial and safety requirements.

name: Capsaicin
description:
Capsaicin (CAS 404-86-4 ), also marketed under the brand names Zostrix and Qutenza®, is the primary pungency compound derived from chili peppers. It is used across pharmaceutical and personal care applications as an active ingredient.

With FEMA number 3404 , it is a recognized flavoring substance in regulated contexts. Its commercial value lies in its activity as a topical analgesic agent and as a functional ingredient in cosmetic formulations.

In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it is the active substance in prescription-strength topical patches and over-the-counter creams. These are formulated for localized pain relief, particularly in neuropathic and musculoskeletal indications.

Personal care formulators incorporate it into warming hair care products and scalp serums where stimulation of blood flow is desired. It is used as a pharmaceutical intermediate in the synthesis of drug delivery systems.

In functional food and flavor applications, it serves as a regulated pungency reference compound for product standardization. Capsaicin is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder with synthetic and natural grades.

Standard commercial grades include pharmaceutical-grade material meeting USP and Ph. Eur. specifications. Technical-grade material is also available for non-regulated applications requiring specific pungency levels.

Concentration and purity specifications typically range from 95% to 99%+ for pharmaceutical procurement. This ensures consistent performance in both medical formulations and high-end personal care products globally.

name: Fluorescent brightener 378
description:
Fluorescent Brightener 378 (CAS 40470-68-6 ), commercially known as CBS-127, is a stilbene-based optical brightening agent used to enhance the perceived whiteness and brightness of substrates.

By absorbing UV light and re-emitting it as visible blue fluorescence, it counteracts yellowing in finished materials without altering their base formulation during the manufacturing process.

In plastics and polymer processing, CBS-127 is incorporated into polyolefins, PET, and engineering resins to deliver high-whiteness aesthetics in packaging films, molded parts, and synthetic fibers.

Paper and board manufacturers apply it during coating or surface sizing to meet brightness specifications required by premium print and packaging grades for commercial use.

Textile producers use it in finishing baths for synthetic fabrics where conventional washing-based brighteners are unsuitable. Coating and adhesive formulators add it to white and near-white systems.

This additive is essential where long-term brightness retention under UV exposure is a commercial requirement. It is supplied as a fine yellow-green powder with defined fluorescence intensity.

Technical and industrial grades are the standard market offering, with specifications typically covering active content, melting point range, and solvent compatibility for various industrial applications.

Packaging is available in kilogram quantities through to bulk bags depending on application volume. This ensures flexibility for both small-scale testing and large-scale industrial production needs.

name: Hexene
description:
Trans-2-Hexene (CAS 4050-45-7 ), also known commercially as Orgal F 4050, is a linear alpha-olefin isomer used as a reactive monomer and process solvent in petrochemical and polymer manufacturing.

It serves as a building block in synthesis chains where controlled chain length and double-bond positioning are critical to end-product performance in various industrial sectors.

In polyolefin production, it functions as a comonomer to modify the density and mechanical properties of polyethylene grades used in film, pipe, and packaging applications.

Refinery and gas processing operations use it as a reference compound and process intermediate in alkylation and isomerization units to ensure high-quality chemical output.

In industrial and institutional cleaning formulations, it contributes to solvent blends targeting hydrocarbon-based soils and residues where fast evaporation and low polarity are requirements.

Specialty chemical synthesis also draws on it as a C6 olefin intermediate for producing plasticizers, lubricant additives, and surfactant precursors for global manufacturing chains.

The product is supplied as a clear liquid, typically in drum, IBC, and bulk tanker quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes and large-scale logistics operations.

Technical-grade is the standard commercial specification, with purity levels commonly ranging from 97% upward depending on specific application requirements and catalyst testing needs.

name: 2-Octyldodecanoic acid
description:
2-Octyldodecanoic acid (CAS 40596-46-1 ), also known as 2-Octyllauric acid, is a branched-chain fatty acid used across personal care, lubricant, and coating formulations.

Its branched structure resists crystallization at low temperatures, making it a preferred building block where conventional straight-chain fatty acids would solidify or perform inconsistently.

In personal care, it functions as an emollient base and emulsifier in skin creams, lip products, and color cosmetics, contributing to smooth spreadability without a greasy residue.

Lubricant formulators incorporate it into metalworking fluids and specialty greases where low-temperature flow and boundary lubrication performance are critical for industrial operations.

In coatings and adhesive systems, it acts as a rheology modifier and dispersing aid, improving pigment wetting and film uniformity across various application surfaces.

Sealant and elastomer manufacturers use it as a processing aid to control viscosity and enhance substrate adhesion, ensuring high performance in demanding environmental conditions.

2-Octyldodecanoic acid is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades, with cosmetic-grade material meeting high purity standards.

Packaging typically ranges from drums to IBC containers, with bulk quantities available for industrial buyers seeking reliable supply for large-scale manufacturing requirements.

name: DL-Carnitine
description:
DL-Carnitine (CAS 406-76-8 ) is the racemic form of carnitine, a quaternary ammonium compound used across pharmaceutical, nutritional, and cosmetic manufacturing sectors.

Unlike the biologically active L-form, the DL-racemate serves primarily as a reference standard, synthetic intermediate, or cost-effective ingredient where stereospecificity is not a requirement.

In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it is used as a synthetic precursor and analytical reference material during the production and quality control of L-Carnitine-based drug substances.

Nutritional supplement formulators may incorporate it in products where racemic composition is acceptable under regional regulatory frameworks for specific dietary applications.

In cosmetic formulations, it functions as a stabilizing and antioxidant-active ingredient in skin-conditioning creams and various anti-aging topical products for consumers.

Animal feed applications include its use as a nutrient additive in aquaculture and livestock feed where carnitine supplementation supports metabolic function in target species.

The product is supplied as a white crystalline powder and is available in technical and pharmaceutical-grade specifications characterized against USP or in-house standards.

Bulk quantities are standard for industrial procurement, with smaller lots available for laboratory and quality control applications to meet diverse manufacturing needs.

name: AA/AMPS copolymer
description:
AA/AMPS copolymer (CAS 40623-75-4 ) is a synthetic anionic polymer combining acrylic acid and AMPS monomers, commercially recognized under the name Acrylic acid-AMPS copolymer. It functions as a scale inhibitor and dispersant.

This threshold agent is designed for systems where conventional polyacrylates underperform due to high hardness, temperature, or pH conditions. In industrial water treatment, it inhibits calcium carbonate and calcium sulfate scale.

It is also effective against calcium phosphate scale in cooling towers, boilers, and reverse osmosis systems. The polymer is particularly effective at low dosage under high-stress conditions found in modern industrial plants.

Textile and paper processors use it as a dispersant and sequestrant to prevent mineral deposition during dyeing and bleaching operations. This protects equipment and improves process consistency across various manufacturing stages.

Home care and industrial cleaning formulations incorporate it as a builder and anti-redeposition agent in detergents. Its sequestration capacity reduces reliance on phosphates, supporting more sustainable cleaning solutions.

Personal care manufacturers apply it as a rheology modifier and stabilizer in gel-based and emulsion systems. It improves texture and the suspension of insoluble actives in various cosmetic and hygiene products.

AA/AMPS copolymer is supplied primarily as an aqueous solution, with active content typically ranging from 40% to 50%. Technical grade is the standard offering for water treatment and industrial applications.

Specifications vary by molecular weight and monomer ratio, which should be confirmed with suppliers based on the target application. This ensures the polymer meets the specific performance requirements of the end user.

name: Sulisobenzone
description:
Sulisobenzone (CAS 4065-45-6 ), also marketed as Benzophenone-4, is a water-soluble UV absorber that protects formulations and substrates from UV-induced degradation across a broad absorption range.

Its water solubility distinguishes it from most benzophenone-series UV filters, making it the preferred choice where oil-free or aqueous systems are required for specific industrial applications.

In personal care, it is incorporated into sunscreens, hair care products, and leave-on formulations to provide UV protection in water-based systems where oil-soluble filters are incompatible.

Coatings and ink manufacturers use it to prevent photodegradation of pigments and binders in aqueous coatings, paper coatings, and packaging inks, extending print and coating durability under light exposure.

Adhesive and sealant formulators add it to water-borne systems to stabilize polymer matrices against UV-driven yellowing and embrittlement during the lifecycle of the finished product.

It also functions as a UV stabilizer in textile treatment liquors, protecting dyed fabrics from light-induced color fading and maintaining the aesthetic integrity of the treated materials.

Sulisobenzone is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. Cosmetic-grade material meeting USP and Ph.Eur. specifications is standard for personal care applications.

Technical-grade material is also available for industrial coatings and ink end uses, ensuring high performance and stability across various manufacturing and chemical processing sectors.

name: Trifluoroacetic anhydride
description:
Trifluoroacetic anhydride (CAS 407-25-0 ), commonly abbreviated as TFAA, is a highly reactive acylating agent used across pharmaceutical synthesis, specialty polymer production, and chemical manufacturing.

It activates and protects functional groups in complex organic molecules, enabling reactions that would otherwise require harsher or less selective conditions for the manufacturer.

In pharmaceutical and agrochemical synthesis, TFAA introduces trifluoroacetyl groups to amines, alcohols, and other nucleophiles, supporting the production of APIs and intermediates.

Polymer and specialty materials manufacturers use it to modify surface properties and introduce fluorine content into polymer backbones, improving thermal stability and flame retardant performance.

In textile and leather processing, TFAA-based treatments contribute to surface modification and preservation chemistry, extending material durability and enhancing the quality of the finished goods.

Printing and packaging applications leverage its reactivity in the preparation of specialty coatings and functional additives where controlled acylation is required for high-performance results.

TFAA is supplied as a colorless liquid, typically in high-purity grades suited to pharmaceutical and fine chemical synthesis. Standard commercial offerings include reagent-grade and technical-grade specifications.

Purity levels are commonly at 99% or higher for synthesis-critical applications. Packaging ranges from small laboratory quantities to bulk drums for industrial procurement and large-scale operations.

description:
1,1,4,4-Tetrafluoro-1,3-butadiene (CAS 407-70-5 ) is a fluorinated diene monomer used as a building block in the synthesis of specialty fluoropolymers. Its difluorovinylidene end groups make it reactive in polymerization systems.

These coatings are designed to withstand repeated exposure to caustic and acidic chemistries. It also serves as a co-monomer in research and pilot-scale production of novel fluorinated elastomers for industrial use.

This chemical allows for precise control over chain structure and crosslink density in specialized applications. It is supplied as a liquefied gas or stabilized liquid, typically in cylinder or lecture bottle formats.

These formats are suited to laboratory and small-scale industrial use. It is available at research and technical grades, with purity levels commonly specified for monomer-grade applications to ensure consistency.

name: Sodium stearyl fumarate
description:
Sodium stearyl fumarate ( CAS 4070-80-8 ), commonly abbreviated as SSF, is a pharmaceutical-grade lubricant and flow aid used primarily in solid dosage manufacturing. Sodium monostearyl fumarate and sodium octadecyl fumarate are recognized alternative names encountered in supplier and regulatory documentation.

It functions as a tablet and capsule lubricant, reducing die-wall friction during compression and improving powder flow in high-speed tableting operations. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, SSF is the preferred lubricant for direct compression and roller compaction processes.

This material is particularly useful where magnesium stearate sensitivity or compatibility issues arise with active ingredients. Food manufacturers use it as a dough conditioner and anti-sticking agent in starch-based and extruded products.

In personal care formulations, it acts as a binder and texture modifier in pressed powders and solid cosmetic sticks. Polymer processors incorporate it as a processing aid and internal lubricant to improve melt flow and surface finish in thermoplastic compounds.

Sodium stearyl fumarate is supplied as a fine white powder. It is available in NF and Ph. Eur. grades for pharmaceutical applications, with food-grade material meeting FCC specifications for food and nutraceutical use.

Technical-grade material is also offered for polymer and industrial applications. This versatile compound ensures consistent performance across diverse manufacturing environments, from high-speed tablet presses to industrial polymer extrusion lines.

In personal care, it thickens and stabilizes shampoos, liquid soaps, and conditioning formulations while enhancing foam quality. Textile and leather processing operations use it as a softening agent.

It acts as a lubricating agent during fiber treatment and finishing stages. In metalworking fluids and cutting oils, it improves lubricity and helps stabilize emulsions under high-load conditions.

Industrial and household cleaners incorporate it to boost detergent viscosity and improve soil suspension in hard-surface and heavy-duty formulations for various commercial environments.

Ricinoleic diethanolamide is typically supplied as a viscous liquid or paste. It is available in technical and industrial grades suited to cleaning, textile, and metalworking applications.

name: Diethylene glycol diacrylate

Diethylene glycol diacrylate (CAS 4074-88-8 ), also referred to commercially as oxydiethylene diacrylate, is a bifunctional acrylate monomer used as a reactive crosslinker and diluent in UV- and peroxide-curable systems.

Its dual acrylate functionality enables rapid network formation, giving formulators control over cure speed, crosslink density, and final film hardness. In UV-curable coatings and inks, it acts as a reactive diluent.

This monomer reduces viscosity without introducing volatile organic compounds, while contributing to crosslink density in the cured film. Printing and packaging applications rely on it for fast-curing flexographic and screen inks.

Adhesion and abrasion resistance are critical performance targets in these applications. In adhesive and sealant formulations, it builds cohesive strength by tying polymer chains into tighter networks during cure.

Polymer manufacturers also incorporate it as a crosslinking comonomer in acrylic resins and hydrogel matrices. This is particularly useful where controlled swelling behavior is a specific formulation requirement.

The product is supplied as a clear liquid, typically inhibited with hydroquinone monomethyl ether to prevent premature polymerization during storage and transport. This ensures stability throughout the supply chain.

name: Diethylpropargylamine
description:
Diethylpropargylamine (CAS 4079-68-9 ), also known as 3-(Diethylamino)propyne, is a tertiary propargylic amine used as a reactive building block and polymerization initiator in specialty chemical synthesis.

Its terminal alkyne group makes it a practical handle for constructing more complex molecular architectures in pharmaceutical and polymer research. In pharmaceutical synthesis, it serves as an intermediate for drug candidates.

This is particularly useful in CNS and enzyme-inhibitor programs. The terminal alkyne functionality supports copper-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition click chemistry, enabling efficient conjugation steps in medicinal chemistry.

In polymer science, it functions as an initiator or co-monomer for synthesizing stimuli-responsive or functionalized polymers where pendant amine and alkyne groups are both required for the final application.

Biotechnology researchers use it to introduce clickable handles onto biomolecules for labeling, immobilization, or probe development. Diethylpropargylamine is supplied as a liquid for various industrial uses.

It is available primarily at research and development scales, with high-purity grades suited to pharmaceutical intermediate and life sciences applications. Bulk quantities for scale-up synthesis can be sourced easily.

name: Sodium palmitate
description:
Sodium palmitate (CAS 408-35-5 ) is the sodium salt of palmitic acid, produced through the saponification of palm-derived fats and oils. It functions as a surfactant, emulsifier, and foam-control agent across food processing and industrial cleaning applications.

In soap and personal care manufacturing, it is a primary fatty acid soap base that contributes lather structure and bar hardness in solid soap formulations. Food processors use it as an emulsifier and anti-foaming agent in baked goods and processed fat systems.

Textile and leather operations apply it as a lubricant and processing aid during fiber treatment and hide preparation. It is essential where controlled slip and emulsification are required for high-performance industrial manufacturing environments.

In paper manufacturing, it supports sizing and surface treatment processes that improve water resistance and printability. This versatile chemical ensures consistent results across various substrates and mechanical processing stages in large-scale production.

Sodium palmitate is supplied as a white to off-white powder or flake. Food-grade and technical-grade specifications are the most commonly traded forms, with food-grade material conforming to FCC or relevant regional food additive standards.

Purity levels typically range from 90% to 99%, depending on grade and intended application. Our supply chain ensures that all batches meet rigorous quality control measures for consistency and performance in your specific industrial formulation.

name: Quaternium 15
description:
Quaternium 15 (CAS 4080-31-3 ), also known commercially as Dowicil 100, is a formaldehyde-releasing preservative used across industrial and personal care formulations to control microbial growth.

It functions as a broad-spectrum biocide effective against bacteria, yeast, and mold in water-based systems. In personal care and cosmetics, it preserves rinse-off and leave-on products.

This includes shampoos, conditioners, and lotions at low use concentrations. Industrial water treatment systems rely on it to prevent microbial fouling in cooling towers and process water circuits.

Coatings and adhesive manufacturers incorporate it into water-based paints, latex adhesives, and sealants to extend shelf life and in-can stability during long-term storage.

Textile, leather, and paper processing operations use it to protect wet-processed materials and finished goods from bacterial and fungal degradation during production and storage.

The chemical is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades, with cosmetic-grade material conforming to specific standards.

These specifications are relevant for personal care registration and compliance. Packaging typically ranges from kilogram quantities up to bulk drum supply depending on the grade.

name: p-toluenesulfonyl isocyanate
description:
p-Toluenesulfonyl isocyanate (CAS 4083-64-1 ), commonly known as tosyl isocyanate or PTSI, is a reactive isocyanate reagent used across coatings, adhesives, and polymer systems.

It functions primarily as a crosslinking agent and moisture scavenger, reacting with hydroxyl and amine groups to build or stabilize polymer networks in various industrial applications.

In polyurethane coatings and adhesives, PTSI acts as a crosslinker that improves chemical resistance and film hardness without requiring elevated cure temperatures for the final product.

Sealant and elastomer formulators use it to scavenge residual moisture from systems sensitive to premature gelation, extending pot life and improving shelf stability during storage.

In textile and leather finishing, it enables durable bonding of functional coatings to fiber substrates by reacting with surface hydroxyl groups to create a strong chemical bond.

Plastic and polymer manufacturers incorporate PTSI as a reactive building block in specialty monomers where controlled isocyanate functionality is required for specific material properties.

p-Toluenesulfonyl isocyanate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. Technical grade is the standard commercial form, with purity specifications typically ranging from 97% upward.

Packaging options generally include small reagent quantities through to drum-scale volumes for industrial procurement, ensuring flexibility for both laboratory and large-scale manufacturing needs.

name: Magnesium myristate
description:
Magnesium myristate (CAS 4086-70-8 ), also known as magnesium tetradecanoate, is a magnesium salt of myristic acid used across pharmaceuticals, personal care, and polymer processing.

It functions primarily as a lubricant, flow modifier, and plasticizer in solid and semi-solid systems. In pharmaceutical tablet manufacturing, it acts as a die-wall lubricant that reduces ejection force.

This material prevents sticking without significantly retarding dissolution. Personal care formulators incorporate it into pressed powders, foundations, and loose cosmetic powders to improve slip and adhesion.

It enhances texture on skin and provides a smooth application. In polymer compounding, it serves as an internal lubricant and processing aid that reduces melt viscosity during manufacturing.

The additive improves surface finish in extruded or molded parts. It is also used in specialty coatings and wax-based systems where controlled rheology and softening behavior are required.

Magnesium myristate is supplied as a fine white powder, the standard form for both pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications. It is available in pharmaceutical-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications.

The pharmaceutical supply typically aligns to excipient standards relevant to tablet formulation. Bulk quantities are offered in fiber drums or multi-wall bags suited to industrial procurement.

name: Silicon carbide
description:
Silicon carbide (CAS 409-21-2 ), commonly referenced by its abbreviation SiC, is a synthetically produced abrasive and refractory material used across high-temperature and high-wear industrial environments.

It delivers exceptional hardness and thermal stability that make it a preferred material in demanding structural and processing applications. In abrasives manufacturing, SiC is used to produce grinding wheels.

It is also used for cutting discs, sandpapers, and blasting media for machining hard metals, ceramics, and composites. Refractory producers incorporate it into kiln furniture, furnace linings, and crucibles.

These components must withstand extreme thermal cycling without degradation. The electronics and semiconductor industries rely on SiC wafers and substrates for power devices, including inverters and EV drivetrain components.

High voltage and high-temperature performance are critical in these sectors. In metallurgy, it functions as a deoxidizer and carbon/silicon additive in steel and cast iron production, improving melt quality.

Silicon carbide is supplied as crude material, macrogrits, microgrits, and fine powder, with particle size being the primary specification variable across applications. Established grades include metallurgical-grade.

Other grades include refractory-grade and semiconductor-grade, each with distinct purity thresholds. Black SiC and green SiC are the two commercially recognized variants, differentiated by purity level.

These variants are selected based on the targeted application. All materials are processed to meet rigorous industrial requirements and ensure consistent performance in heavy-duty manufacturing environments.

description:
1,3,2-Dioxaphosphorinane, 2,2′-oxybis[5,5-dimethyl-, 2,2′-disulfide , also known by CAS 4090-51-1 , is a specialized phosphorus-sulfur compound. It is widely utilized as an antioxidant and extreme-pressure additive in various industrial formulations.

This chemical functions by providing both antioxidant stabilization and lubrication performance in demanding processing environments. It is particularly effective in systems requiring high thermal stability and chemical resistance.

In lubricant and metalworking fluid formulations, it acts as an extreme-pressure and anti-wear additive. It protects metal surfaces under high-load conditions, preventing surface damage and reducing friction during heavy industrial operations.

Petroleum and synthetic base oil blenders incorporate this compound to extend fluid service life. By inhibiting oxidative degradation, it ensures that lubricants maintain their viscosity and performance characteristics over longer periods.

In plastics and polymer processing, it functions as a processing stabilizer. It helps prevent thermal oxidation during compounding and extrusion, ensuring the structural integrity of the final polymer product is maintained.

Its dual phosphorus-sulfur functionality makes it relevant for gear oils, hydraulic fluids, and grease formulations. It is ideal for applications where combined antioxidant and extreme-pressure performance is strictly required.

This product is typically supplied as a solid powder or crystalline material for easy handling. It is available in technical grade, which is perfectly suited to industrial lubricant and polymer additive applications.

Packaging is generally offered in kilogram-scale bags or drums depending on specific volume requirements. Our logistics team ensures that all shipments meet the necessary safety standards for industrial chemical distribution.

name: Trisaminoethylamine
description:
Trisaminoethylamine (CAS 4097-89-6 ), commercially known as TREN, is a tetradentate triamine used across polymer chemistry, metal treatment, and specialty formulation.

Its four nitrogen donor sites make it effective for chelating metal ions and initiating controlled polymerization reactions in various industrial and laboratory settings.

In coatings and adhesives, TREN functions as a curing agent and cross-linker for epoxy systems, contributing to network density and adhesion performance in demanding industrial formulations.

Water treatment operations use it as a chelating agent to sequester heavy metal ions, preventing scale formation and equipment fouling in process water circuits during operation.

In polymer manufacturing, TREN serves as a ligand in atom transfer radical polymerization (ATRP), enabling precise molecular weight control in specialty plastics and elastomers.

Lubricant and metalworking fluid formulators incorporate it for its metal-complexing capacity, helping to stabilize formulations and protect metal surfaces under high-load conditions.

Trisaminoethylamine is supplied as a liquid. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity levels typically specified at 96–99% depending on the application tier.

Buyers sourcing for sensitive polymer or coordination chemistry applications should confirm purity specifications directly with the supplier to ensure the material meets requirements.

name: Isophorone diisocyanate
description:
Isophorone diisocyanate ( CAS 4098-71-9 ), commonly known as IPDI, is an aliphatic cycloaliphatic diisocyanate monomer used to build polyurethane polymers with superior UV and weathering resistance.

Unlike aromatic isocyanates, IPDI-based systems retain color stability over time, making it a preferred building block where appearance and outdoor durability are non-negotiable for manufacturers.

In automotive and industrial coatings, IPDI is reacted with polyols to produce two-component polyurethane topcoats and clearcoats that resist yellowing under prolonged UV exposure during service life.

Aerospace and defense applications rely on IPDI-based polyurethane systems for protective coatings on aircraft exteriors and structural components where long-term performance under harsh environmental conditions is critical.

Adhesive and sealant formulators use IPDI to crosslink moisture-cure or two-part systems bonding plastics, composites, and metals in demanding assemblies. It also serves as a building block for dispersions.

IPDI is supplied as a clear to slightly yellow liquid in standard industrial packaging including drums and IBC containers. It is available in technical and industrial grades for various uses.

Purity specifications are typically at 99%+ for polymer-grade applications. Prepolymer and trimer forms are also commercially available for formulators requiring modified reactivity or reduced vapor pressure.

Vinyltriacetoxysilane (CAS 4130-08-9 ) is an acetoxy-functional silane coupling agent used to improve adhesion and compatibility between inorganic substrates and organic polymer systems.

It releases acetic acid upon hydrolysis, enabling reactive bonding at mineral surfaces while introducing a vinyl group for further polymerization or crosslinking applications.

In sealants and adhesives, it acts as a crosslinker and adhesion promoter for silicone-based formulations applied to glass, metal, and concrete substrates for industrial use.

Coatings manufacturers use it to improve substrate wetting and film adhesion on difficult surfaces, particularly in automotive and industrial protective coatings and finishes.

In polymer compounding, the vinyl functionality allows grafting onto polyethylene and other polyolefins, improving filler dispersion and overall mechanical performance of the material.

Electronics applications include encapsulants and potting compounds where reliable bonding to housing materials and circuit substrates is critical for long-term component protection.

Vinyltriacetoxysilane is supplied as a clear liquid, typically in drums and IBC containers. Technical grade is the standard offering, with purity specifications commonly at 97% or higher.

name: Potassium pyruvate
description:
Potassium pyruvate (CAS 4151-33-1 ) is the potassium salt form of pyruvic acid, offering improved stability and handling compared to the free acid. It functions as a pH buffer, acidulant, and metabolic substrate across food, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology applications.

In food and nutrition products, this compound is used as a flavoring agent and acidulant. It frequently appears in sports nutrition and dietary supplement formulations targeting energy metabolism support for active consumers.

Pharmaceutical manufacturers incorporate it as a buffering agent in injectable solutions and topical preparations. Precise pH control is critical to product stability and efficacy in these specialized medical applications.

Biotechnology and cell culture laboratories use it as a carbon source and metabolic supplement in growth media. It supports cell viability and productivity in fermentation and mammalian cell culture processes.

It also serves in cosmetic formulations as a pH-regulating ingredient in skin-conditioning products. This versatility makes it a staple for formulators requiring high-purity metabolic intermediates for diverse uses.

The material is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. Food-grade and reagent-grade specifications are the most commonly available, with some suppliers offering material compliant with USP requirements.

name: Ultraviolet Absorber UV 292
description:
Ultraviolet Absorber UV 292 (CAS 41556-26-7 ), also marketed as Sabostab UV 65, is a hindered amine light stabilizer (HALS) designed to protect organic materials from photodegradation caused by UV exposure.

By interrupting the radical chain reactions triggered by light, it extends the service life of polymer-based products across demanding outdoor and industrial applications. This ensures long-term durability.

In coatings formulations, including automotive refinishes and industrial topcoats, UV 292 prevents gloss loss, chalking, and color fade under prolonged UV exposure. It is essential for maintaining aesthetic quality.

Adhesives and sealants used in construction and automotive assembly incorporate it to maintain bond integrity and flexibility after weathering. This prevents structural failure in harsh environments.

Flexible and rigid plastic substrates, including polyolefins and engineering polymers, are stabilized during processing and throughout their end-use lifetime. This protects the physical properties of the material.

Printing inks and packaging films destined for outdoor or high-UV environments use UV 292 to preserve print quality and structural performance. It prevents the degradation of pigments and film strength.

UV 292 is supplied as a liquid, which simplifies incorporation into solvent-borne and liquid resin systems without requiring dissolution steps. This improves manufacturing efficiency for chemical processors.

name: Melamine phosphate
description:
Melamine phosphate (CAS 41583-09-9 ) is a halogen-free flame retardant salt produced from the reaction of melamine and phosphoric acid. It functions by releasing non-combustible gases and forming a protective char layer when exposed to heat.

This mechanism interrupts combustion in polymer systems and coatings. In intumescent coatings and paints, it acts as the acid source component, enabling the char-forming reaction that protects structural steel and wood substrates.

Building and construction applications rely on this protection for safety. Plastics processors incorporate it into polyolefins, polyamides, and epoxy systems to meet UL 94 and other flame retardancy standards required in components.

These standards are essential for automotive and electronics manufacturing. Textile and paper manufacturers apply it in back-coating formulations to achieve flame retardancy certification for upholstery and curtains.

It is also used for industrial fabrics and in rigid and flexible foam systems. These systems are common in aerospace and defense applications where halogen-free compliance is a strict procurement requirement.

The product is supplied as a white powder in various particle size distributions to suit compounding and coating processes. Technical grade is the standard commercial form for most industrial uses.

Purity levels are typically specified at 98% or above to ensure performance. Packaging is available in 25 kg bags, with bulk options available for high-volume industrial buyers requiring large quantities.

name: Propylene glycol phenyl ether
description:
Propylene glycol phenyl ether (CAS 41593-38-8 ), also known as 1-(2-Methylphenoxy)-2-propanol, is a slow-evaporating glycol ether solvent used across coatings, cleaning, and polymer formulation.

Its controlled evaporation rate and compatibility with a broad range of resins make it a preferred choice where film formation and flow need to be managed precisely in industrial settings.

In architectural and industrial coatings, it functions as a coalescing agent and flow promoter, improving film leveling in waterborne and solvent-based systems for better surface finishes.

Formulators of hard-surface and industrial cleaners incorporate it to boost soil penetration and surfactant efficiency in concentrated products, ensuring high performance in heavy-duty applications.

In adhesive and sealant systems, it supports resin dissolution and workability, extending open time in reactive formulations to allow for more precise application and bonding.

Plastics processors use it as a plasticizer and processing aid where temporary softening or compatibility with polymer matrices is required during the manufacturing of various components.

Propylene glycol phenyl ether is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes. It is available in technical grade for standard use.

This grade is the standard specification for coatings, cleaning, and polymer applications. Purity levels and moisture content are typically controlled to meet formulation-sensitive end uses.

name: Ethoxylated bisphenol A dimethacrylate
description:
Ethoxylated bisphenol A dimethacrylate (CAS 41637-38-1 ) is a bifunctional methacrylate monomer used as a reactive diluent and crosslinker in UV- and peroxide-curable polymer systems.

The ethoxylated backbone reduces viscosity compared to standard bisphenol A dimethacrylate, improving processability without sacrificing crosslink density in the cured network.

In UV-curable coatings and inks, it contributes to hard, chemically resistant films with controlled flexibility. This balance makes it suitable for wood, metal, and plastic substrates.

Dental and industrial adhesive formulators use it as a base monomer where toughness and dimensional stability under cure are required for high-performance applications.

In photopolymer printing plates and packaging laminates, it supports fast cure response and strong substrate adhesion under high-throughput conditions for industrial manufacturing.

Composite and structural adhesive manufacturers incorporate it to tune crosslink density and mechanical performance in fiber-reinforced systems and specialized engineering components.

Supplied as a clear to pale yellow viscous liquid, standard commercial grades are available at varying ethoxylation levels, typically EO2 to EO10, which affect final properties.

These levels directly affect viscosity, flexibility, and hydrophilicity. Buyers should confirm ethoxylation degree and methacrylate equivalent weight against specific formulation requirements.

name: Isostearyl isostearate
description:
Isostearyl isostearate (CAS 41669-30-1 ) is a branched-chain ester of isostearic acid and isostearyl alcohol, used across personal care and industrial formulations as an emollient, lubricant, and plasticizer.

Its highly branched molecular structure resists crystallization at low temperatures, making it a preferred choice where stability across a wide temperature range is a procurement requirement for manufacturers.

In color cosmetics and skincare, it functions as a skin-conditioning emollient and spreading agent in lipsticks, foundations, and creamy formulations, contributing slip and a non-greasy after-feel.

It is used in hair care products to soften and add gloss without the heaviness associated with straight-chain esters. This makes it ideal for high-end formulations requiring a premium sensory profile.

Industrial lubricant formulators incorporate it as a base fluid or additive in metalworking fluids and specialty lubricants where oxidative stability and low-temperature performance are required for operations.

As a plasticizer, it improves flexibility and workability in wax-based and pigment-dispersed systems. This versatility allows for its use in a broad range of technical and chemical processing applications.

Isostearyl isostearate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow viscous liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the differing purity requirements of global users.

Personal care manufacturers and industrial users can rely on consistent quality across batches. Bulk supply is standard in drums and IBCs to accommodate large-scale production and logistics needs.

name: Dipalmitoyl hydroxyproline
description:
Dipalmitoyl hydroxyproline (CAS 41672-81-5 ), also known commercially as LIPACIDE DPHP, is a lipophilic derivative of hydroxyproline used in personal care formulations.

It combines a fatty acid component with an amino acid to deliver moisturizing and stabilizing activity within oil-based systems. Formulators source it primarily as a skin-conditioning active.

In facial and body care emulsions, it functions as a humectant that supports moisture retention within the lipid phase of the formulation. It is incorporated into anti-aging creams and serums.

Its antioxidant properties help protect formulation integrity and support skin barrier function. Hair care products such as conditioning treatments use it to deliver amino acid-derived benefits.

Its lipophilic character also suits it for anhydrous formats including balms, sticks, and oil serums where water-soluble actives cannot be used effectively in the manufacturing process.

Dipalmitoyl hydroxyproline is typically supplied as a waxy solid or powder suitable for incorporation into the oil phase of cosmetic formulations. It is available in cosmetic-grade specification.

2-Phenoxy-1-propanol (CAS 4169-04-4 ), also known as 2-Phenoxypropanol, is a glycol ether-type alcohol used as both a solvent and a preservative across industrial and personal care formulations.

Its dual functionality allows formulators to consolidate ingredients while maintaining microbial control and solvency in a single component. In personal care and cosmetics, it functions as a broad-spectrum preservative.

It is used as a co-solvent in lotions, creams, and rinse-off products, often paired with other preservative actives to achieve full-spectrum efficacy. Coatings and adhesive manufacturers use it as a coalescing solvent.

It acts as a rheology modifier in waterborne systems, where it supports film formation and improves substrate wetting. In printing inks, it acts as a slow-evaporating solvent that controls drying speed.

This material reduces printhead clogging in inkjet and flexographic applications. Sealant and elastomer compounders incorporate it as a processing aid and biocide carrier to extend shelf life in moisture-sensitive formulations.

Isostearyl lactate (CAS 42131-28-2 ), also known as isooctadecyl lactate, is an ester of isostearyl alcohol and lactic acid used primarily as an emollient and skin-conditioning agent in cosmetic formulations.

Its branched-chain structure delivers a lightweight, non-greasy skin feel that positions it as a preferred alternative to heavier esters in leave-on and rinse-off products. In personal care, it functions as an emollient.

It acts as a spreading agent in facial moisturizers, sunscreens, and color cosmetics, improving texture and skin adhesion without occlusive heaviness. Formulators also use it as a plasticizer and softener.

This material is utilized in film-forming systems, including nail care and hair coating products. In lubricants and metalworking fluids, it contributes lubricity and acts as a coupling agent between components.

It bridges polar and non-polar components effectively. Coatings and adhesive formulations incorporate it to improve flexibility and substrate wetting in specialty applications across various industrial sectors.

Isostearyl lactate is supplied as a clear, pale liquid suitable for direct incorporation into oil phases or anhydrous systems. It is available in cosmetic-grade quality meeting personal care industry standards.

name: Glycol palmitate
description:

In personal care formulations, it acts as an emulsifier and skin-conditioning agent in creams, lotions, and body butters, improving texture and moisture retention. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a plasticizer in tablet coatings and controlled-release formulations.

Where flexibility and film integrity are critical, this ester provides reliable performance. In food processing, it supports emulsification in fat-based systems and coatings where a palmitate-derived ester meets clean-label or functional requirements.

Cosmetic formulators also incorporate it into hair care products to improve spreadability and deposit conditioning actives more uniformly. This versatility makes it a staple ingredient for manufacturers seeking to enhance product stability and sensory profiles.

name: Neopentyl glycol dioleate
description:
Neopentyl glycol dioleate (CAS 42222-50-4 ) is a diester of neopentyl glycol and oleic acid used as a synthetic base fluid and functional additive in high-performance lubricant formulations.

Its ester structure delivers strong lubricity and thermal stability, making it a preferred choice where petroleum-based fluids fall short. It is evaluated by formulators primarily for lubricant and plasticizer applications.

In automotive and industrial lubricant blending, it functions as a synthetic base oil component or co-base fluid in gear oils, compressor oils, and hydraulic fluids requiring improved viscosity retention.

Aerospace and defense lubricant manufacturers incorporate it into formulations for aircraft turbine oils and specialty greases where oxidative stability under extended service conditions is critical for safety.

As a plasticizer, it is used in polymer processing to improve flexibility and processability in specific elastomer and synthetic rubber compounds. This enhances the durability of the final industrial product.

Metalworking fluid formulators also use it as a lubricity additive in cutting and forming fluids to reduce tool wear and improve surface finish. This ensures high precision during the manufacturing process.

Neopentyl glycol dioleate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in technical grade for industrial and lubricant applications, meeting standard commercial requirements for purity.

Packaging typically ranges from drums to intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) depending on order volume. Proper storage in a cool, dry environment is recommended to maintain the chemical integrity of the ester.

name: Arachidyl behenate

Arachidyl behenate (CAS 42233-14-7 ), also known as icosanyl docosanoate, is a long-chain fatty acid ester derived from arachidyl alcohol and behenic acid. It functions as a structuring wax, rheology modifier, and lubricant across personal care, industrial coatings, and polymer applications.

In cosmetic formulations, it builds solid structure in stick products, lip balms, and emollients. It provides a smooth, non-greasy skin feel that supports premium texture positioning for high-end consumer goods.

Industrial lubricant formulators use it as a solid lubricant additive where high-melting wax esters are needed. It is particularly effective at reducing friction under load in demanding mechanical environments.

In coatings and sealants, it acts as a surface modifier and slip agent. This improves mar resistance and enhances the overall application properties of finished films and protective layers.

Polymer and plastics compounders incorporate it as an internal or external lubricant to aid processing. It helps reduce melt adhesion during extrusion and improves the flow of materials during manufacturing.

Arachidyl behenate is supplied as a white to off-white solid, typically in flake or powder form. It is available in cosmetic-grade quality meeting personal care industry purity standards for global compliance.

name: Isobutylparaben
description:
Isobutylparaben (CAS 4247-02-3 ), also known as isobutyl 4-hydroxybenzoate, is a paraben-series preservative used across food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic manufacturing.

It inhibits microbial growth in finished formulations, extending product shelf life across a broad range of applications. In cosmetics and personal care, it functions as a preservative.

It is used in creams, lotions, and emulsions where longer oil-phase compatibility is required compared to shorter-chain parabens. Pharmaceutical manufacturers incorporate it into topical preparations.

It is also used in oral suspensions and semi-solid dosage forms to prevent microbial contamination during storage. Food-grade applications include use as an antimicrobial agent.

This applies to certain processed food products where regulatory frameworks permit paraben use. It also appears as an intermediate in the synthesis of more complex paraben esters.

Isobutylparaben is supplied as a white crystalline powder. Standard commercial grades include food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade material, with the latter typically conforming to USP specifications.

The material may also conform to Ph. Eur. standards. Packaging is available in kilogram-scale quantities for laboratory and formulation use, as well as larger bulk formats.

name: Lauroyl arginine
description:
Lauroyl arginine (CAS 42492-22-8 ) is a cationic amino acid-based surfactant derived from lauric acid and L-arginine. It functions as a broad-spectrum antimicrobial agent and surface-active ingredient across personal care, food, and pharmaceutical applications.

In cosmetic formulations, including rinse-off and leave-on products, it provides preservation activity against bacteria, yeasts, and molds. This functionality helps manufacturers reduce their reliance on conventional parabens or isothiazolinones.

Food manufacturers use this compound as a surface treatment agent on fresh produce and processed foods. It effectively controls microbial contamination, which is essential for shelf life extension and maintaining product safety standards.

In pharmaceutical topical preparations, it supports preservation while contributing mild conditioning and wetting properties. These characteristics improve skin feel and formulation spreadability for various medical and therapeutic creams.

Personal care formulators also incorporate it into hair care products where its cationic nature promotes substantivity to hair and scalp surfaces. This ensures the active ingredient remains effective even after the rinsing process.

Lauroyl arginine is commercially available as a white to off-white powder or as a liquid dispersion. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commonly supplied versions for industrial and commercial manufacturing needs.
